Title:
Full Stack Developer
Location:
Hybrid (Warrington, United Kingdom)
Company:
GTMaritime (Valstone Portfolio)

About the Company:
GT Maritime provides mission-critical maritime cybersecurity and communications software to 2,000 companies and 16,000 vessels worldwide — roughly a quarter of the world's non-navy fleet. Based in Warrington, UK, GT Maritime operates as a focused, technically rigorous business with a strong culture of quality and long-term ownership. GT Maritime is part of the Valstone portfolio.

About Valstone:
Valstone is an industrial software conglomerate that acquires and operates mission-critical software businesses across agriculture, logistics, food processing, bulk materials, and manufacturing. With 19 acquisitions completed across Canada, the USA, and the UK, Valstone takes a long-term, buy-and-hold approach — building businesses rather than exiting them. Valstone is part of the Valsef Group, a Montreal-based holding company. Sister entities include Valsoft (130+ acquisitions, $3B+ valuation), Permanent Corp, Valnet, and Valsef Capital.

Valstone at a Glance (Part of the Valsef Group)
19 acquisitions completed
4 core verticals
Canada, USA and UK operations
Buy and hold — no exit horizon
$200M revenue target by 2026

About the Role:
Reporting to the Head of Engineering, this Full Stack Developer role sits at the centre of GT Maritime's next phase of product development. The team is building the next generation of GT Maritime's platform — the layer where customers see what is happening across their entire fleet.

This hire will design and build partner API integrations across the cybersecurity stack — endpoint protection, network security, user awareness training, and SIEM/SOC tooling — and set the standard for test-driven development across the codebase. This is a hands-on, permanent role. You will not just build to spec — you will model TDD practice for the rest of the team through the code you write every day.

Responsibilities

𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭
Design and build partner API integrations across GT Maritime's cybersecurity stack — endpoint protection, network security, user awareness training, and SIEM/SOC tooling.
Write clean, modular, well-tested code following object-oriented design principles. Participate in code reviews and hold a high bar for what ships.
Work within six-week Shape Up build cycles, collaborating with the Head of Engineering and Product on scoping, requirements, and effort estimation.
Use AI-powered development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as standard instruments throughout the development workflow.

𝐓𝐞𝐬𝐭-𝐃𝐫𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 & 𝐐𝐮𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲
Champion and model TDD practice across the team — write tests first, every time, and make that standard infectious.
Own test coverage, regression strategy, and acceptance criteria validation for integration code.
Contribute to post-release reviews and continuous improvement of the delivery process.

𝐒𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐲
Promote secure coding practices and conduct security-focused code reviews aligned with ISO 27001 certification.
Support vulnerability identification and remediation as part of the everyday development workflow.
Enforce least-privilege access and secure infrastructure configuration across the integration layer.

𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐎𝐩𝐬 & 𝐈𝐧𝐟𝐫𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬
Work alongside DevOps to understand and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, AWS resource management, and deployment practices.
Support monitoring, logging, and alerting improvements that help the team detect and resolve issues faster.

Qualifications

𝐅𝐮𝐥𝐥 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 — 3+ years of hands-on commercial experience building and shipping features in a SaaS environment. C# / .NET Core is the core backend language. Vue.js with Nuxt 3 is the front-end framework.
𝐓𝐞𝐬𝐭-𝐃𝐫𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 — Writes tests first. Can coach peers. TDD is non-negotiable at GT Maritime.
𝐀𝐏𝐈 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 — Proven experience with REST, OAuth2, webhooks, rate limiting, and retry patterns. Has integrated with third-party commercial APIs at production scale.
𝐒𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐲 & 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐥𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 — Working knowledge of application security fundamentals and ISO 27001 / secure-by-design principles.
𝐂𝐥𝐨𝐮𝐝 & 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐎𝐩𝐬 — Familiar with AWS (EC2, RDS, Lambda, S3) and CI/CD pipelines. Comfortable with microservices and distributed processing architectures.
𝐀𝐈-𝐀𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 — Comfortable using AI-powered development tools as everyday instruments. Candidates who are resistant to AI-assisted development will not be a good fit for this team.
𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐢𝐚𝐥 𝐀𝐈 𝐀𝐏𝐈 𝐄𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 — Has written production code calling Claude API, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, or similar.

Who Fits This Role:
GTMaritime is a lean, close-knit team. The culture runs on trust, ownership, and showing up for the work. This is the profile that fits.

Broad by Nature
- Does not need a narrow lane to operate effectively. Comfortable moving between a feature build, a security review, and a release checklist in the same week.

📍London/ Hybrid

£115,000 - £135,000 + £50,000 share options + Benefits

💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage
to manage patient demand, and Self-Book
, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires
for long-term conditions, while Accumail
finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe
, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

The team

Our engineers have sat in GP waiting rooms. They've watched practice managers juggle three systems at once to send a single message to a patient. They build for that person.

What sets our Product Engineers apart is that they own the problem, not just the code. They shape what gets built and how - working with Product, Design and Clinical from the earliest stages - and they stay with the systems they build as they evolve. They bring engineering judgment into product decisions, and product thinking into engineering ones.

Our stack is primarily C# on the backend, TypeScript and React on the frontend, running on Azure. ML/AI work uses Python. We don't expect you to know all of it - we expect you to follow a problem wherever it leads.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning features end-to-end: from refining the problem with clinicians and product managers through to architecture, implementation, rollout, and long-term evolution
Engaging directly with NHS GPs, practice staff and patients to build a genuine understanding of the problems you're solving — research sessions, visiting practices
Designing architecture and API boundaries with the broader system in mind, not just the immediate surface
Holding the quality bar for what you ship: not just that the code works, but that the product is reliable, intuitive and safe in a clinical context
Making the architectural calls that keep our codebase sustainable — improving system health alongside shipping features, not instead of it
Pushing back constructively when something is wrong, and committing fully when a decision has been made

What Experience You Need To Be Successful

Comfortable building production software across the stack - you might be strongest in backend or frontend, but you can follow a problem across both to own a feature end-to-end
Proven ability to reason about systems - breaking ambiguous problems into tractable pieces, spotting trade-offs and second-order effects before they become incidents
Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage problem definition; you shape the work rather than wait for a finished spec
You treat engineering quality as part of the job - managing technical debt pragmatically, reviewing AI-generated output critically, and pushing for the right architectural decisions under real constraints
Curiosity about AI tools and how they change the way you work, with the judgment to know when to rely on them and when not to

What we’re looking for to demonstrate as a Product Engineer at Accurx

You start from the user problem, not the technology. You know what to build, what not to build, and why. In the AI era, that also means knowing what to delegate, what needs human judgment, and what shouldn't exist at all.
You can break ambiguous problems into tractable pieces and see how those pieces connect across boundaries. You spot seams, trade-offs, and second-order effects — thinking both from big to small and small to big.
You can pick up unfamiliar code, systems, and assess AI-generated output. You spot flaws before being told, and you understand why something is wrong.
You have strong expertise in at least one area and can use it to build, debug, and improve real systems effectively. You know what “great” looks like in your domain and can reliably get there.
You own outcomes, not just tasks. You influence across teams, navigate disagreement to reach the right answer, own your mistakes, and push hard for the wins that matter.
You actively experiment with AI tools to push the boundaries of what's possible today, with the scepticism to avoid overhyping what they can do.
You're actively learning and experimenting with AI tools, pushing the boundary of what's possible today, with the healthy scepticism that keeps you from overhyping what they can do.

What’s in it for me?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to fix healthcare communication.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Head of Engineering (Hands-On)

Opportunity overview

Blüm Health is a fast-growing digital health software company founded by Clinicians and Software Engineers to break down the barriers of healthcare innovation. A bit about us; we've spent the start of our journey investing in a great approach to software architecture, focusing on developer experience and making our projects great code bases to work with. What we have achieved empowers our development team to spend most of their time innovating instead of managing tech debt.

The Head of Engineering role is the technical centre of gravity for that delivery. You'll own engineering quality and predictability across multiple concurrent projects, protect the shared platform that lets us move quickly without breaking things, and stay hands-on in the code where it has the most leverage. It's a role for someone who wants to shape how a team builds, not just what it builds. Is this role of interest to you? Reach out today to discuss this further.

Brief details of the role

Hybrid: Yes, with a certain number of days required in the London office (next to Tower Bridge) each month
Tech stack: C#, .Net, Azure, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, Entity Framework, GraphQL, React
Projects: Private Healthcare and Public Healthcare clients including NHS
Greenfield work: Yes
Reports to: Chief Technical Officer

Blüm is a UK leader in clinical innovation, realising, designing, and delivering scalable software products. We collaborate with both Public and Private sector clients, including the NHS, to optimise the clinician and patient experience, whilst looking at new ways of analysing existing processes to make them more efficient. Our mission is to connect Healthcare excellence with technological innovation, accelerating the transition to a world filled with digital health solutions.
We believe in putting the best people together and empowering them to create, deliver and excel. We celebrate diversity of thought, interest, perspectives, and ideas, regardless of ethnicity, religion, gender orientation, sexual orientation, or national origin. To understand more about Blüm Health click here. You can also visit https://www.blumhealth.co.uk/ and follow us on LinkedIn @blumhealth.

The ideal candidate is a technical leader who hasn't stopped building. You'll set the pace and the standard for engineering across the business. Through the code you write, the reviews you give, and the leads you develop, while making sure what we commit to clients is what we can actually deliver.

Who you are

Leadership

Promote diversity, inclusion, and equality of opportunity, respecting difference and external experience. Welcome and respond to challenges from others, despite any conflicting pressures to give in to them. Stand by, promote, or defend your own and the team's decisions where needed. Some key leadership qualities that a Head of Engineering should possess include:

Technical authority without gatekeeping: Deep expertise across the stack, used to raise the ceiling for everyone else rather than to centralise decisions. You should be the person others want in the room on a hard problem, not the person they have to wait for.
Scaling through others: The ability to identify and empower trusted technical leads who can run teams day-to-day, reducing reliance on any single person for reviews or critical knowledge (including yourself!).
Comfort holding a line: Quality gates, security posture and release readiness are yours to defend. That sometimes means an unpopular conversation with delivery or with a client, handled well.
Coaching instinct: Growing engineers is part of the job, not an overflow activity. You reinforce an open culture where any engineer can raise an issue.

Seeing the big picture

As the senior technical leader in the engineering function, it is important to understand the goals and direction of the company and how engineering decisions serve them. This means holding architecture choices against commercial and operational constraints rather than ideology; monolith, modular, serverless or queues based on what the problem actually needs. To be aware of the bigger picture, a Head of Engineering can:

Participate in decision-making and offer ideas for the direction of the wider engineering function
Understand where the business is winning and losing, and what that implies for platform investment
Keep an eye on delivery performance (estimate versus actual, rework, incident patterns) and act on what it shows
Research the digital health industry and stay up to date with the latest trends and developments
Network with other professionals in the field and gain insights into the industry

Communication and influencing

Communicate with others in a clear, honest, and enthusiastic way to build trust. Explain complex issues in a way that is easy to understand. Deliver difficult messages with clarity and sensitivity, being persuasive when required. Remain open-minded and impartial in discussions, whilst respecting the diverse interests and opinions of others.

For this role specifically, that extends to client-facing work: supporting bid and specification responses with credible feasibility assessments, joining technical deep dives where risk or complexity is high.

Requirements

We are looking for an engineering leader who enjoys new challenges and creative problem solving, and who is comfortable operating across different projects in a fast-moving team. You'll be someone who treats estimation as a discipline rather than a ritual, and who applies critical thinking to high-level requirements whilst optimising delivery routes within operational constraints (security, resilience, compliance).

jobs.title: Solution Engineer - Data
jobs.description:
Overview

As a Solution Engineer – Data, you will help organisations modernise their data estates — from operational databases to enterprise analytics — and unlock business value through Microsoft Fabric, and AI-ready data foundations.

Working alongside account teams, specialists, and partners, you will engage customers throughout their transformation journey, from initial strategy discussions through to technical validation and adoption. You will combine deep technical expertise with industry understanding to design solutions that help customers migrate and modernise mission-critical databases, build enterprise-grade data and analytics architectures, and ground AI on their own data — improving decision-making and creating AI-ready foundations.

You'll work with data leaders, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to showcase how Microsoft's Data & AI platform — including Azure SQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Cosmos DB, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Data Services, and Copilot capabilities — can accelerate innovation and deliver measurable business outcomes.

As a member of the team, you will lead the most complex and strategic customer engagements, influence at architect and executive level, and mentor colleagues — establishing yourself as a recognised technical leader in Data & AI solutions.This role offers the opportunity to work with leading organisations across a broad range of industries, supporting their next-generation data and AI initiatives.

Responsibilities

Lead strategic customer engagements by helping organizations modernize their data, analytics, and AI platforms to achieve business outcomes.
Serve as a trusted technical advisor, translating complex business challenges into scalable cloud, data, and AI solutions.
Design and deliver solution demonstrations, workshops, architecture reviews, and proof-of-concept engagements that support customer decision-making.
Partner with sales, customer success, engineering, and partner teams to develop technical strategies that accelerate customer transformation and drive business growth.
Guide customers in adopting modern data platforms, analytics capabilities, governance practices, and AI-enabled experiences.
Build strong relationships with technical and business stakeholders, influencing architecture and technology decisions throughout the customer lifecycle.
Contribute to competitive strategies, technical readiness, and solution innovation by sharing market insights, customer feedback, and best practices.
Mentor peers, contribute to technical communities, and help build a culture of continuous learning, inclusion, and customer obsession.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related discipline or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in technical pre-sales, solution architecture, consulting, data engineering, database administration, analytics, or cloud technology roles.
Experience designing or implementing enterprise-scale data, database, and analytics solutions.
Experience engaging with both technical and business stakeholders in customer-facing environments.

Required Technical Experience

Experience with operational and transactional databases - including SQL Server, Azure SQL (Database & Managed Instance), Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and Cosmos DB - alongside modern analytics platforms.
Hands-on database migration and modernisation experience, including estate assessment, heterogeneous migration (for example Oracle/PostgreSQL to Azure), and modernisation tooling.
Hands-on experience building end-to-end analytics solutions in Microsoft Fabric — Lakehouse/Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Spark and notebooks, semantic models, Power BI, and Real-Time Intelligence — or comparable modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Understanding of enterprise-grade non-functional requirements — high availability, disaster recovery, performance tuning, security, resilience, and cost optimisation — across both mission-critical databases and analytics platforms (including Fabric capacity sizing and workload/cost management).
Familiarity with AI grounding on databases, including vector stores, RAG, and connecting operational data to AI and Copilot experiences.
Understanding of data engineering, data warehousing, analytics, governance, and modern data architectures across cloud-native and hybrid environments.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

jobs.description:
Job Title:
Application Operations Engineer - Tech CSC - Counter Terrorism Policing HQ
Salary:
The starting salary is £46,985, which includes allowances totalling £3,009.
The salary is broken down as £43,976 basic salary, which will increase annually until you reach the top of the scale £49,670. Plus, a location allowance of £2,009 and a non-pensionable allowance of £1,000.
Location:
CSC, West Midlands

Job Summary

As an Application Operations Engineer, you'll support business-critical systems that are vital to our work in an ITIL-aligned environment. It's an IT role like no other, which comes with excellent training and the chance to build your skills. The Customer Service Centre (CSC) provide IT support to the Counter Terrorism Policing network. With the growing threat to National Security, we need to add to our dedicated teams. It's your chance to play your part in supporting UK policing.
This role is aligned to the Application Operations Engineer
role set out within the Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework (DDAT).
Thanks to fast-evolving technology, new applications are being developed for policing all the time. Your task will be to help support this growing area by tackling applications-related issues. Day-to-Day, you'll assist the Senior Application Operations Engineers and Data Engineers in maintaining the Applications portfolio to ensure we have an accurate record of supported applications. You'll also be an escalation point for all applications-related incidents, managing them through to resolution. Whenever new or improved applications roll out, your role will be key in making sure that live support is seamless.
We want you to take the initiative when it comes to good working practices and processes. So you'll need experience of applications management and ideally, knowledge of ITIL-environments. With this expertise, you'll feel confident taking responsibility for outstanding faults, liaising with users and the other technical teams.
While an understanding of Microsoft development tools is essential (IIS, .NET, MS-SQL, Visual Studio), you should be just as adept with people – and be able to explain technical issues simply and form good working relationships. If you can combine customer service experience with strong IT literacy, we can offer you an exciting role in a supportive team. The applications in our portfolio are mostly bespoke, but we'll make sure you get first-class training and an excellent work/life balance.
Join us, and you’ll be part of a team of engineers covering core working hours weekdays from the CSC operations centre and on call (roughly 1 week in 8). The role is office-based with occasional opportunities to work from home.
Key Tasks

The post holder will be required to do the following:
Working within a service team monitoring components such as web servers, applications servers, log files, disk space and MS-SQL databases.
A point of escalation for all Application related issues within the Applications Team
Working as part of a second line support function following incident management through to incident resolution. Natural problem solving with ability to apply previous experience to new problems working towards route cause analysis.
Working with third party suppliers, stakeholders and departmental ICT teams to assist in delivering patch/release of applications while coordinating vendor support.
Maintaining middleware such as; IIS, MS-SQL Server, Active Directory, ASP and. NET, including troubleshooting, performance tuning, basic querying and resolving bottlenecks.
Daily support of COTS and WEB based software applications with an emphasis on the ability to problem solve.
Strong customer focus – understanding the needs of the internal and external customer and keeping them in mind when taking actions or making decisions.

Vetting

This post requires access to the most sensitive intelligence material on a daily basis. Applicants must hold or be prepared to undergo National Security Vetting (NSV) Developed Vetting (DV) level before taking up the post.
Please note the successful candidate will be part of a recruitment pipeline for a period of up to 12 months.
Confidentiality Agreement

Applicants should also be aware of the need to sign a confidentiality agreement on taking up the post.
Our Colleague Commitments

Counter Terrorism Policing (CTP) continues to prioritize an inclusive and supportive working environment and culture, where all of our people feel a strong sense of belonging and are empowered to reach their full potential. CTP keeps the nation and everyone in it safe from all manner of threats and as those threats evolve, so do we - that’s why Inclusion, Diversity and Equality (IDE) is the key to supporting our greatest asset, our people.
Our people protect our national security across the UK. In order to continue to deliver against our organizational priorities, we collectively seek to ensure that all colleagues feel respected, supported and valued to fully participate in the delivery of our mission – “working to keep people safe from Terrorism”.
IDE is at the heart of our approach to make the composition of Counter Terrorism Policing more representative of the communities we serve. As Counter Terrorism is rooted in Local Policing, to tackle today’s complex policing challenges, applications from across all backgrounds, cultures and experiences are therefore essential and encouraged. The CTP Network is committed to ensuring that candidates identifying as disabled are able to realize their fullest career aspirations and, as such, will endeavor to accommodate any reasonable adjustments that you may require during the recruitment process. CTP also welcomes applications from candidates seeking flexible working arrangements, . All flexible working arrangements should be discussed and agreed with the hiring manager.
This role does not attract Shift Disturbance Allowance. If you are currently in a shift-working role, SDA should cease upon appointment to this job.
How to apply

To begin your career at the Met, please click the "apply button “. The application process requires a comprehensive CV, a Personal Statement, and an online application form. In your Personal Statement, you should explain your interest in the position and illustrate how your skills and experiences make you a suitable candidate. Please note that you should not submit two copies of your CV, and ensure that your documents are saved in either PDF or Word format, clearly labelled as CV and Personal Statement.
Completed applications must be submitted by 23:55 on 5th October 2026.
Once received, your application will be reviewed against eligibility criteria, following this, your application will be reviewed by the hiring manager.
Following application review, successful candidates will be invited to interview.
www.metpolicecareers.co.uk

Understanding of ITIL process, incident management, change management and problem management including working to strict SLAs.
Ability to understand business logic, technical tools and be an analytic thinker.
An understanding of application backup, restores and the Application Disaster Recovery (DR) process.

Previous experience of Incident and Service Request resolution using Service Management Tools.
An appreciation of Application languages and technologies including SQL, HTML, .Net, C# and IIS hosting.
Experience in utilising appropriate ITIL based Incident, Problem and Change Management processes and procedures to support and maintain applications.

Desirables

Broad understanding of Application languages and technologies including SQL, HTML, .net, C# and IIS hosting.
Previous experience of working in a 2nd Line Application Support role.
ITIL v3/4 – Foundation.

Make your mark at BRE!

BRE is a world-leading global organisation for innovation, science and data in the built environment. For over 100 years, we have supported governments, businesses and industry with pioneering research, testing and expertise. We are focused on growth, scale and expanding our global impact with products, services, standards and qualifications that address the challenges of a changing world. Driven by our purpose of helping everyone, in every building, everywhere, we are creating a safer, more sustainable built environment for people and planet.

Help shape the future of BRE!

We're looking for a Junior Developer to join BRE's Digital Services team and help shape the future of our industry-leading digital platforms, including BREEAM and SmartWaste. This is an exciting opportunity for someone early in their software development career who wants to strengthen their technical skills, work alongside experienced developers, and contribute to products used by customers across the built environment sector.

You'll be supported by a collaborative Agile team and given the opportunity to take ownership of development work, build your expertise, and grow into a confident software professional.

About The Role

As a Junior Developer, you'll be part of a Scrum team responsible for developing, enhancing and maintaining BRE's web-based applications. Working closely with Senior Developers, Product Owners and UI Designers, you'll help deliver new features and improvements that support our product roadmap.

This role offers a great balance of learning and responsibility. You'll be involved throughout the software development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and estimating work through to coding, testing and deployment. As your knowledge grows, you'll take on increasingly complex development tasks and play a bigger role in delivering high-quality solutions that meet customer and business needs.

Develop, maintain and improve web-based applications and services.
Collaborate with Developers, Product Owners and Designers within an Agile Scrum team.
Translate requirements into secure, robust and high-quality code.
Contribute to sprint planning, estimation and delivery activities.
Develop and maintain database components, including stored procedures and views.
Create and consume RESTful web services and APIs.
Support testing activities, including creating and executing test plans.
Troubleshoot and resolve defects and technical issues.
Provide regular updates on progress, risks and delivery timelines.
Follow BRE development standards, processes and best practices.

We're looking for a motivated developer with a solid technical foundation, a willingness to learn, and a passion for building high-quality software.

Understanding of web application development.
Experience with JavaScript and jQuery.
Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, including databases, stored procedures and views.
Understanding of RESTful web services and APIs.
Knowledge of object-oriented programming principles and development methodologies.
Exposure to design patterns such as dependency injection and service-oriented architecture.
Understanding of ORM frameworks.
Familiarity with Agile development environments and Scrum practices.
Experience testing software and supporting quality assurance activities.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering quality work.
Effective organisation and time management skills.

Within your first 2 months

Taking ownership of smaller development tasks.
Building a foundational understanding of BRE's applications, products and development processes.
Becoming an active contributor within your Scrum team.

Within 6 months

Independently delivering larger, straightforward development tasks.
Demonstrating a strong understanding of BRE's applications and development standards.
Contributing confidently to sprint planning and delivery activities.

By the end of your first year

Consistently delivering larger development tasks with minimal supervision.
Having a solid understanding of the application landscape and wider business context.
Helping improve development processes and contributing to team best practice.

Financial & Security Benefits

Pension scheme – 5% employer-matched contribution
Life assurance – 4x your basic salary
Enhanced maternity package

Health & Wellbeing

HealthPartners cashback scheme – Reclaim costs on prescriptions, physiotherapy, dental care, and more
Onsite facilities – Restaurant, nursery, and free parking, including at-cost EV charging points

Career Development

Learning & development – Free access to BRE Academy and our online learning platform
Professional membership reimbursement

For full details on our benefits, visit: BRE Employee Benefits

Work Location Options

Hybrid – This role offers a mix of home and office working. You will need to be within commuting distance of our Watford, as you will be expected to attend in person (2-3 times per week).

Our Recruitment Process

As part of our recruitment process we will be conducting 10-30 minute phone screening calls via an AI recruiter called Ryan with all shortlisted candidates. The information gathered from this screening will be used to help assess your suitability for the position.

Senior Engineer – Data Platform Team | C#/.NET, Kafka, Event Driven / Streaming | Up to £120,000 + Bonus + Benefits | Hybrid | FX Trading Firm | London

I’m currently working with a London-based trading technology team
that’s looking to bring in a Senior Engineer within their Data Platform team
to help scale a real-time platform powering high-volume trading systems
.

This isn’t a typical backend role. It sits at the intersection of high-performance backend engineering and data platform architecture
, focused on building distributed systems that process and stream huge volumes of trading data in real time
.

⚡ When markets become volatile, trade and order volumes can surge instantly
, so the platform needs to remain extremely fast, resilient, and fault-tolerant under significant load
.
The team is looking for engineers who enjoy working on complex systems where scalability, concurrency, and performance really matter
, particularly within event-driven and streaming architectures
.

It’s the kind of environment where you’re solving real engineering problems at scale
, rather than just building standard application features.

💻 Tech Stack

Key technologies include:

• C# / .NET (currently .NET 8 / .NET 10)

• Kafka or similar event-streaming technologies
(RabbitMQ, Kinesis, Azure Service Bus etc.)
• PostgreSQL and large relational data systems

• Real-time data pipelines and distributed systems

🧠 What You’ll Be Doing

• Designing and scaling real-time data ingestion pipelines

• Building and improving event-driven platform services

• Handling large volumes of streaming market data

• Working with product owners to translate requirements into production-ready systems

💰 Package
💰 Salary:
£120K

jobs.description:
.NET Developer | C# .NET | Energy Trading | ETRM | Hybrid – London | £900 | Inside IR35 | 6-Month Rolling Contract

A leading global financial services organisation, providing liquidity, market access and infrastructure services across commodities, financial markets and foreign exchange, is looking to hire a C# .NET Developer
to join their Power & Gas Technology
team.

This C# .NET Developer
opportunity will see you playing a key role in the complete restructuring of a Front Office ETRM trading platform that supports a high-performing Energy Trading desk.
As a C# .NET Developer
, you will be responsible for redesigning and modernising a mission-critical C# .NET trading platform, transforming a legacy application into a scalable, low-latency, event-driven system capable of supporting multiple Front Office traders operating across Power, Gas and Emissions markets.

Working closely with traders, quants and technology teams, you will take ownership of the platform architecture, driving the full software development lifecycle from solution design through to implementation and deployment, while ensuring the platform remains resilient, deterministic and capable of handling real-time market events under volatile trading conditions.

The C# .NET Developer
will work within an Agile engineering team building modern trading applications using C# .NET 8
, Azure and on-premise technologies. You will be responsible for designing scalable event-driven solutions, implementing asynchronous messaging patterns, and delivering high-quality software that supports pricing, P&L, execution management and risk across the Front Office trading environment.

This C# .NET Developer
role offers the opportunity to work with technologies including .NET 8, C#, Azure, SQL Server, Kafka, Solace, LINQ, Entity Framework, Angular and Event-Driven Architecture
. As a C# .NET Developer
, you will contribute to the modernisation of a business-critical ETRM platform while helping shape the long-term technology strategy for one of the industry's leading trading businesses.

Previous experience delivering Front Office Energy Trading
, ETRM
or real-time trading platforms
is essential.

💰 £900/day (Inside IR35)

🗺️ Hybrid working – 3 days on site - London

📆 6-month rolling contract (extensions expected)

🚀 Start date: ASAP

💻 Technology context:

A leading organisation within the financial services sector
is undergoing a major technology transformation, modernising its core trading, data, and analytics platforms. With significant investment into its technology function, the business is building a next-generation platform to support data-driven decision making and improve the way its trading teams operate.

As part of this transformation, the organisation is seeking a Head of Engineering
to lead a growing technology function across software development, data engineering and QA
. This is a senior engineering leadership position with responsibility for technical direction, engineering standards, delivery and team development.

The Opportunity

This is a key leadership role for an experienced engineering leader who enjoys working in a hands-on, technically complex environment. You will lead the engineering function while remaining close to the technology, working with developers, data engineers and QA engineers to deliver high-quality platforms supporting the firm's financial services and trading activities.
You will take ownership of engineering strategy and delivery, helping shape the architecture, development practices and technology roadmap. You will work closely with senior stakeholders across technology and the business to ensure the engineering function continues to support the firm's trading and commercial objectives.

The platform will process and integrate large volumes of data, supporting teams across trading, risk, analytics and operations
. You will have the opportunity to shape a modern engineering function and play a key role in the ongoing transformation of the firm's technology estate.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and develop the engineering function across Software Development, Data Engineering and QA
.
• Own the engineering strategy, technical direction and delivery of critical technology across the firm's financial services and trading platforms.
• Build and maintain a high-performing engineering team, supporting recruitment, development, mentoring and progression.
• Provide technical leadership across architecture, software development, data platforms, testing and system integration.
• Work closely with senior technology and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
• Oversee the development of applications, APIs, microservices and data platforms supporting financial services and trading.
• Establish and maintain strong engineering standards around code quality, testing, deployment and documentation.
• Drive the adoption of modern development practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, cloud technologies and DevOps.
• Ensure close collaboration between developers, data engineers and QA throughout the development lifecycle.
• Help shape the long-term architecture and technology roadmap as the organisation continues its modernisation programme.
• Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, creating a strong culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience leading an engineering function or large engineering team within a complex technology environment.
• Strong background in software engineering, ideally with experience across development, data engineering and QA
.
• Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, microservices and data platforms.
• Experience with C#/.NET would be highly advantageous.
• Strong understanding of cloud technologies, DevOps, CI/CD and automated testing.
• Experience building and developing high-performing engineering teams.
• Comfortable operating at both a strategic and technical level, with the ability to engage with engineers as well as senior business stakeholders.
• Experience working with complex data environments or high-volume, real-time systems.
• Financial services, capital markets, trading or commodities experience would be highly advantageous.

• A strong communicator who can provide clear technical direction while giving engineering teams the autonomy to deliver.

Compensation
: Up to £150,000 + Bonus + Benefits
Location
: Paddington, London
Working Pattern
: 4 days per week in the office

If you’re an experienced engineering leader looking to take ownership of a growing technology function at the heart of a financial services organisation
, send your CV to Joe@virtuetech.io or reply.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Engineer
jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

Matter Administration helps customers grow and scale the eDiscovery practices and businesses they run on Relativity. The team delivers solutions that improve administrator productivity, simplify configuration, and streamline system preparation for matter review.

From matter setup and workspace configuration to data archiving, restore, cost management, and billing solutions, Matter Administration provides the tools and services Relativity Administrators use to manage their environments effectively.

This team is building a greenfield product and owns the full solution lifecycle, from implementation in .NET to deployment through GitHub Actions and monitoring with New Relic. Team members contribute to architecture, influence engineering best practices, and help shape modern, scalable cloud solutions.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary mission will be to design, develop, test, deploy, and support RelativityOne cloud solutions built on Azure using .NET and C#. You will work as part of a Scrum team, collaborating closely with engineering peers and business stakeholders to deliver products, features, and services that evolve the RelativityOne platform.

You will contribute technical expertise across the software development lifecycle, mentor less experienced engineers, and support the team’s technical leadership while helping drive engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Contribute to a Scrum team throughout all phases of the software lifecycle, including conception, design, development, testing, deployment, and operations.
Architect and design performant, scalable, and secure software solutions with a strong focus on quality.
Apply object-oriented analysis, design, and programming principles using C#, TypeScript, and JavaScript, including SOLID principles and design patterns.
Provide technical guidance to help deliver high-quality, secure, and scalable software operating on large volumes of data.
Participate in code reviews and promote engineering best practices.
Develop and execute comprehensive unit and integration testing strategies, including static analysis.
Improve software development processes by identifying and driving meaningful changes.
Identify, document, automate, and engineer solutions for repetitive operational tasks.
Contribute to and mature automated CI/CD deployment and upgrade workflows.
Use monitoring and observability tools to proactively identify and resolve issues.
Improve software quality, completeness, and knowledge sharing across the team.
Troubleshoot production issues, resolve defects, and respond to customer-specific problems.
Coach and mentor team members through technical guidance and education.
Participate in an on-call rotation as a second line of support after gaining sufficient domain experience.
Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, growth, and collaboration.

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience developing commercial software systems and applications using C#.
Experience building cloud-scalable solutions using cloud-native patterns, preferably on Microsoft Azure.
Experience working with scalable database technologies.
Experience building a cloud-focused DevOps mindset, including CI/CD processes and tools such as GitHub Actions, Harness, and LaunchDarkly, along with mature observability practices.
Ability to design and implement mature deployment and release solutions.
Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including unit testing, code reviews, design documentation, debugging, and troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day engineering workflows, including:
AI-assisted code generation, refactoring, and review.
Using AI for technical design, solution exploration, and documentation.
Leveraging AI to plan and structure development and release activities.
Critically evaluating AI-generated outputs and taking ownership of final technical decisions.

Experience working in Agile software teams, including mentoring, feature leadership, and cross-functional collaboration.
Fluency in English.

Preferred

Experience with container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management solutions such as Pulumi.
Experience with observability platforms and monitoring solutions such as New Relic and Grafana.
Experience building web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.
Experience developing applications with .NET Core.

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

Expert-level skills in defining, designing and developing distributed and scalable products and platforms, using reusable domain-specific composable (micro) services running on containers on multi-platform/hybrid clouds (Microsoft Azure preferred) using the respective cloud IaaS/PaaS/SaaS services.
Expert-level skills in multiple application programming and scripting languages (JavaScript, .NET, Java, Python, C++, etc.), SQL and noSQL databases, Bigdata and its processing, Data analytics and Machine Learning, Industry’s recommended authentication/authorization technologies. Understanding of business and organizational strategy and ability to communicate solutions, ideas, suggestions to business partners effectively and comprehensibly.
In-depth knowledge of various design patterns, and architectural styles (e.g., traditional application based as well as microservices and containers, event-driven, data streaming, data transformations and analytics)
Strong collaboration, analytical, interpersonal and communication abilities.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Integration Strategy & Domain Architecture (Freedom & Quality)
Define, design, and govern enterprise-grade integration architectures across our hybrid-cloud ecosystem, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and low latency.
Act as a Segment Domain Expert: Deeply understand the business processes, data flows, and operational nuances of our core business segments (e.g., Petcare, Snacking, Food) to design integrations that solve real business problems.
Architect end-to-end integration flows connecting core enterprise systems, including ERPs (SAP S/4HANA), CRMs (Salesforce), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and Retail POS systems.
Champion API-Led Connectivity and Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) as the foundational paradigms for global business operations.
Establish reusable integration patterns, templates, and frameworks that accelerate time-to-market for digital initiatives across different business units.
Technology Leadership & Platform Governance (Efficiency & Quality)

Provide deep architectural expertise and hands-on design leadership across our core integration platforms:

SAP BTP Integration Suite (SAP BTP IS): Lead core ERP and cloud line-of-business integrations (e.g., Cloud Integration, API Management)
Azure Integration Services (Azure IS): Drive cloud-native workflows, event routing, and messaging using Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, and Azure API Managemen
MuleSoft Anypoint Platform: Govern API portfolios, design reusable RAML/OAS specs, and establish robust runtime engine deployments (CloudHub/hybrid)
Solace PubSub+: Design and implement real-time, high-performance event brokers and streaming frameworks for globally distributed supply chain and manufacturing operations.
OpenText: Architect secure, high-volume B2B integration networks and EDI systems to support transactional exchanges with global retailers and logistics partners.
Collaborate with DevOps and Platform squads to implement modern, automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code for integration deployments.
Stakeholder Collaboration & Mutuality (Mutuality)
Act as a trusted consultant to Business Partners, Functional Leads, and external partners, translating complex business processes into elegant technical designs.
Partner closely with security, data privacy, and compliance teams to enforce robust authentication standards (OAuth, OIDC, SAML), encryption at rest/transit, and compliance with global regulations (GDPR, CCPA).
Present clear, value-driven architectural proposals to digital leadership, demonstrating how technology choices support business enablement.
Continuous Improvement & Associate Mentorship (Responsibility)
Drive a culture of Domain Excellence within the technical team, encouraging developers and junior architects to build deep expertise in specific business segments and processes rather than remaining pure technical generalists.
Keep a pulse on emerging industry trends, cloud paradigms, iPaaS innovations, and modern B2B integration capabilities, steering the technology roadmap accordingly.
Establish a culture of shared learning; mentor junior integration architects and developers, conducting design reviews to elevate collective technical capability.

Required Experience & Qualifications

Industry & Domain Expertise (Mandatory)

CPG/FMCG Sector Experience: Minimum of 5+ years of experience working within a global Consumer Packaged Goods, retail, or manufacturing enterprise (or serving such clients in an architectural consulting capacity).
Segment Domain Mindset: Proven ability or strong desire to move beyond purely technical execution to become a true domain expert in core CPG business processes, specifically:
Order-to-Cash (O2C): Customer orders, pricing, billing, and retail POS integrations.
Procure-to-Pay (P2P): Supplier interactions and procurement flows.
Supply Chain & Logistics: Logistics execution, 3PL/4PL integrations, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), inventory visibility, and product serialization (GS1 standards).

Technical Stack & Platform Expertise

MuleSoft Anypoint Platform: Solid experience designing and governing API-led connectivity, managing API policies, and configuring CloudHub.
Azure Integration Services: Proven expertise with Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, and Azure APIM.
SAP BTP Integration Suite: Deep hands-on experience integrating SAP environments (S/4HANA, ECC) with external cloud platforms and cloud LOBs (Ariba, SuccessFactors).
Solace PubSub+: Experience implementing event mesh networks, real-time message routing, and publish/subscribe patterns.
OpenText: Proven track record in B2B/EDI integration, automated document processing, and managed integration services (EDIFACT, ANSI X12, AS2, SFTP standards).
Modern Protocols & Formats: Expertise in REST, SOAP, gRPC, JSON, XML, and flat-file integration patterns.

Soft Skills & Leadership

Principle-Driven Leadership: Ability to operate under a values-based framework, demonstrating strong personal accountability and mutual respect.
Collaborative Mindset: Strong active listening, communication, and negotiation skills, with an innate ability to build bridges across global, multicultural teams.
Problem-Solving & Agility: Strong analytical capability, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced, digital environment.

Education & Certifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a highly related field.
Professional certifications in relevant technologies (e.g., MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, SAP Certified Integration Associate, or Solace Certified Engineer) are highly desirable.

Company Description

Netcompany was founded in 2000 with the headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark. Today, we are an international company with more than 9000+ employees working from over 10 locations. We serve a wide array of customers in their digital transformation journeys in public and private sectors across Europe.

We are excited by the challenge of doing things differently. At Netcompany we rely on one another and we develop quickly. We are team players. We change societies by creating life-changing IT solutions for variety of customers – from small private companies to large projects in the public sector. Our culture builds on low bureaucracy with a strong focus on high agility and flexibility.

Job Description

Continue your development with us

In Netcompany we focus on your personal and professional development. We offer a structured career model where you can build upon the experiences you bring with you.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will be your sparring partner for your ongoing development as well as for your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in the leadership group provides you with concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and wishes.

Furthermore, you will participate in our training program, Netcompany Academy, where you will be offered courses and seminars tailored to your career stage. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your expertise. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company also creates a strong network and provides a solid foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Be a part of an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we prioritize community highly. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture that is built on collaboration and trust, and where there is always room for mutual sparring and support.

It is part of our culture and values that all employees, irrespective of backgrounds, identities, and experiences, are met with understanding and respect, as well as equal opportunities for development and well-being.

You will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate with colleagues from various cultures and nationalities, as we are an international company with offices in many countries.

We provide a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we offer a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network already early in your career.

As our new colleague in the Cloud Platform Services team, you will play a key role in agile projects for both large Danish and international customers. You have a unique opportunity to be part of a team responsible for multiple disciplines: Cloud Governance, Cloud Operations, Cloud Center of Excellence, and Cloud Consultancy.

We design and implement business-critical solutions on state-of-the-art infrastructure for customers, where you get hands-on experience with Azure. You will help build and operate our central architecture and solutions, impacting all our cloud solutions across all customers. You will ensure operations in the intersection of infrastructure, security, and the development of customer solutions. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to be lent out to other projects within the organization as a cloud consultant for both shorter and longer periods. All of which we convert to services that enhance and develop our central capability.

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, your tasks will include:

Monitoring, alerting, automation, and scaling of cloud solutions.
Creating coherence between development, operations, and security in accordance with DevOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tasks, e.g., Terraform, Bicep.
Operating with Version controlling system, e.g., Git.
Automation and standardization of Cloud Infrastructure processes (PowerShell/ Azure CLI).
Design and implementation of Cloud governance solutions.
Delivering internal methods/methodologies/principles into customer projects.
Leading or contributing to technical initiatives in the internal cloud infrastructure through experience from customer projects.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

Have a bachelor's, master's, or engineering degree in ICT/IT, computer science, software/computer engineering, infrastructure, or other relevant vocational education experience.
Have experience with coding/scripting (.NET, Java, Web, PowerShell, Python) and/or DevOps (Terraform, CI/CD) from education or previous work.
Have experience with Azure or other Global Cloud Providers (e.g., AWS, GCP, OCI) from education or previous work.
Possess an analytical mindset, are motivated, and know how to work in a structured manner.
Have good communication skills and Teamwork.
Have an excellent command of the English Language (written & verbal).
Have to be a member of the on-call duty shift outside of business hours.
It would be beneficial (but not a must) if you:
Have work experience.
Have experience with infrastructure and operations.
Have experience with IaaS or PaaS services in cloud-hosted environments.
Have certification in Azure or other relevant Microsoft areas.
Have experience with Kubernetes, containers, or Docker.

Additional Information

Benefits we offer:

Scandinavian work environment.
Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, Multisport Card.
English and Danish language lessons.
Drinks, snacks & fruit available at the office.
Career development programme for each employee and regular feedback.
Internal and external training and certifications.
International cooperation with colleagues from Denmark, the Netherlands, Norway, the UK, and Vietnam.
Attractive office with a view and great location in Warsaw (Metro Wilanowska).

Do you still have questions?

Please upload your CV to our recruitment system via the link. If you haven't received answers to all your questions, feel free to reach out to pl.hr@netcompany.com

We are a Disability Confident Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment that welcomes every individual. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. jobs.description:
Company Description

InPost Group
(Euronext: INPST) is Europe's leading out-of-home e-commerce delivery platform, operating over 50,000 automated parcel machines (APMs) and PUDO points across Poland, the UK, France, Italy, and Benelux
- processing tens of millions of transactions annually. Beyond logistics, InPost is building a full e-commerce services layer: InPost Pay is our integrated checkout and payments product embedded directly into the merchant journey
, with ambitions that extend into digital wallets, embedded finance, and AI-assisted commerce. This is fintech at logistics scale - and we are just getting started.

Job Description

As you probably know, a lot is happening at InPost. We build products and services that support millions of users and transactions every day. One of the key areas within our ecosystem is InPost Pay, where we develop solutions focused on digital payments, checkout experiences, and sales enablement.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager who will take ownership of a growing engineering organization within the Pay domain
. This is an opportunity for a leader who can scale teams, develop engineering leaders, drive technical excellence, and remain a credible partner in architectural and technology discussions.

What will you be responsible for?

Driving the growth and scalability of technology teams supporting payment, checkout, and sales-related products.
Leading an engineering organization of approximately 24–25 engineers across 3 teams:
two teams led through Engineering Managers,
one team managed directly.

Developing Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and senior engineering talent while building a strong leadership pipeline.
Establishing and maintaining technical, architectural, and delivery standards across the entire domain.
Shaping technology strategy in close collaboration with Product, Business, and Engineering stakeholders.
Managing dependencies across teams and ensuring high-quality delivery at scale.
Identifying and removing organizational and technical bottlenecks that impact product development and business outcomes.
Defining and driving the domain's AI adoption strategy, identifying opportunities where AI can improve engineering productivity, software quality, and operational efficiency.
Promoting responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation across engineering teams while measuring business and engineering impact.
Leading the organization through data-driven decision-making by defining, monitoring, and improving domain-level KPIs, OKRs, SLAs, and engineering performance metrics.
Using engineering insights and metrics to continuously improve delivery effectiveness, platform reliability, team productivity, and customer outcomes.
Representing the engineering organization in strategic initiatives and cross-functional leadership discussions.

Qualifications

An ideal profile includes:

10+ years of experience in software engineering and technology leadership.
Experience managing Engineering Managers and multi-team engineering organizations.
Strong technical foundation gained as a Software Engineer.
Hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.
Excellent understanding of distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and modern backend engineering practices.
Experience working with cloud environments (Google Cloud is a strong advantage).
Experience defining technical standards, SDLC processes, governance models, and engineering operating frameworks.
Ability to translate engineering strategy into measurable business outcomes and effectively communicate with senior stakeholders.

Must have:

Hands-on technical background in the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot) or equivalent enterprise microservices stack (e.g., .NET/C#); sufficient depth to be a credible technical partner in architecture reviews and engineering decisions.
Experience within a production environment.
Experience operating in large-scale product organizations.
Proven success in building and scaling engineering organizations through leaders.
Experience implementing or scaling AI-enabled engineering practices and tools.
Strong understanding of engineering metrics, KPIs, OKRs, and organizational performance management.
Ability to use data and measurable outcomes to drive technology and organizational decisions.

Nice to have:

Experience in fintech, digital payments, checkout platforms, or embedded finance products.
Experience working in organizations building payment processing, commerce, digital wallet, or transaction-heavy platforms.
Background in successful technology scale-ups that have grown both products and engineering organizations rapidly.
Experience in regulated crypto fintech - crypto exchanges, digital asset custodians, or blockchain-based payment infrastructure operating under financial supervision (e.g., MiCA, FCA, or equivalent licensing frameworks).
Demonstrated impact of AI adoption on engineering velocity, developer experience, or software quality.
Experience building management dashboards and using data analytics to drive strategic decisions.

Additional Information

Why Join InPost?

Opportunity to work in a diverse, international, and cross-functional environment, along with leading experts.
You work and learn from a senior leader and their leadership bench, extending your experience and exposure in the e-commerce and logistics industry.
 InPost is a growing company that offers an increasing number of opportunities in several locations in Europe.
Fulfilling careers with a range of benefits, training opportunities for self-development.
You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and circular economy every day.
Excellent working environment and Flexible hours.

What will you do?

As a Staff .NET Developer at Rebtel you will serve as the technical guardian and principal individual contributor for the entire Backend (BE) architecture and ecosystem. This role is crucial for ensuring the technical excellence, scalability, reliability, and security of all backend systems that power our core products and services. The Staff Software Engineer will operate at a high level of abstraction, influencing engineering practices across multiple teams while remaining hands-on in critical areas.

You’ll be actively involved in architectural decisions, contribute to technical discussions, and inspire your team to deliver clean, robust code.

Responsibilities And Tasks

Lead the design, development, and deployment of complex, high-throughput backend services and APIs, ensuring best-in-class performance and maintainability.
Drive architectural decisions and serve as the ultimate technical escalation point for BE-related challenges.
Establish and articulate a clear, ambitious long-term vision and technical roadmap for the evolution of the BE systems.
This includes planning for future growth, anticipating technological shifts, and driving the adoption of new technologies and patterns to maintain a competitive edge.
Act as the primary architect for major system initiatives, defining microservices boundaries, data models, integration patterns, and deployment strategies.
Proactively identify and resolve technical debt and architectural risks before they impact the business.
Mentor engineers, elevating the technical expertise and quality of engineering output across the organization.
Influence engineering standards and best practices for testing, performance tuning, and security across different development teams.

Requirements

Exceptional and proven proficiency in the .NET area, including extensive experience with C#, .NET Core/8+, and related frameworks (e.g., ASP. NET Core, Entity Framework Core).
Must demonstrate the ability to architect and build high-performance, fault-tolerant systems using the .NET stack.
Demonstrable architecting skills with a strong background in designing and implementing large-scale, distributed systems (e.g., microservices, event-driven architectures, serverless).
Expert knowledge of design patterns, domain-driven design (DDD), and SOLID principles.
Extensive experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and related services (e.g., managed databases, message queues, containerization).

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, driving consensus on critical architectural decisions.

Why Rebtel?

Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.

Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.

Pension Plan

Dental Insurance
Occupational insurance

Discount on gym memberships
Bonus program
Extra parental pay
30 days annual vacation
Monday breakfasts
Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.

We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Rebtel is a company of about 70 people from 31 countries who share a common mission to empower diaspora communities around the world to stay connected to where they come from. From our office in central Stockholm, we help our user base of 1 million dual-culture people—predominantly from the global south—connect with and support their communities through affordable data-free international calling and mobile top-ups. With our app and online platform, we help dissolve the space between their worlds so they can live more connected lives.

,

Design, build and operate AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, using tools and collaborating with other agents
Build end-to-end AI-enabled workflows using n8n
Develop reusable capabilities and integrations for our AIKA Agent platform
Connect AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, data sources and business processes

An inclucive work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment

Excellent verbal and written English

Are you an experienced Java developer who takes end-to-end ownership, makes deliberate architectural choices, and wants real influence over a platform built on Azure and Kubernetes?

Then you might be the Senior Backend Developer our Mestro team in Stockholm is looking for!

As Part of the Department

We craft the vertical software of tomorrow, bringing sustainable impact to customers and society. At Mestro, we combine data-driven innovation with a genuine passion for energy efficiency and sustainability. As part of EG Group, we are a dedicated team of innovators and problem solvers who take responsibility for our contribution to our customers, each other, and the society we live in.

We are now looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join Mestro on a permanent, full-time basis, contributing to the continued development of the platform. This is a hybrid role with our Stockholm office as your base. You will combine days on site with the team and days working remotely.

Your Tasks: Design, Build, and Own the Backend

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will be one of the people the team relies on for the backend systems powering the Mestro platform. You will design and build new functionality, improve what we already have, and work closely with product owners, architects, and frontend developers to turn business goals into technical solutions that hold up over time.

You Will

Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs for the Mestro platform.
Drive architectural and technical decisions, and take responsibility for their consequences.
Deploy, monitor, and operate applications in Azure and Kubernetes. You build it, you run it.
Identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability issues.
Set the bar for code quality through well-tested code and constructive code reviews.
Break down complex and unclear requirements together with product owners and turn them into solutions that can be delivered.
Mentor colleagues and raise the level of the whole team, not just your own output.

Your Profile: An Experienced Developer Who Takes Ownership

You have enough experience to know that writing the code is rarely the hard part. You make pragmatic trade-offs, communicate clearly about risk and scope, and take ownership of your work all the way into production. You want to work in a small team where your opinion carries weight, and where you are expected to have one.

You Are The Ideal Candidate If You

Have 8-10 years of professional experience in backend development.
Have deep knowledge of Java, and solid experience with MS SQL and Azure.
Have hands-on experience building and running applications in Kubernetes.
Have a strong grasp of software architecture and distributed systems, including the trade-offs they involve.
Have experience mentoring developers and driving technical decisions in a team.
Communicate confidently in English, both in writing and in technical discussion.

Nice To Have

Experience designing and operating microservice architectures.
Strong CI/CD and DevOps practices: pipelines, infrastructure as code, and observability.
Experience with large data volumes, time series data, or integrations with external data sources.
Background in the energy management, proptech, or data analytics domain.

What's in it for you?

A product with real purpose. Mestro helps buildings across Europe cut energy waste, so your code has tangible impact.
Real technical influence. You will shape architecture and priorities, not just close tickets.
A modern tech stack: Java, Azure, Kubernetes, MS SQL.
Autonomy with support. We trust you to own your work, and we back you when you need it.
A hybrid setup with our Stockholm office as your base, and a collaborative, low-ego culture.
The stability and resources of EG Group behind a product team that still moves fast.
Room to grow, whether deeper into architecture, DevOps, or domain expertise in energy management.

Our Values

Lead the Industry — We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry.
Make it Happen — We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact.
Stronger Together — We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.
