jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect
to join a consulting team supporting a Swedish municipality in strengthening its capabilities across data, analytics, cloud platforms and digital development.
The assignment covers the setup, development and ongoing management of Microsoft Fabric, Azure - including Landing Zones - Power BI, Microsoft 365 and AI solutions, including Power Platform. Microsoft Fabric brings together data movement, data engineering, data science, real-time analytics and BI, while Azure Landing Zones provide a governed and secure foundation for scaling Azure workloads.
You will work closely with business and IT stakeholders, helping translate organisational needs into practical, secure and scalable technical solutions. The engagement covers the full journey: needs analysis, requirements workshops, target architecture and roadmap development, implementation, documentation, governance and knowledge transfer. The project will start in October. You will work in Tyresö.
Key responsibilities

Design target architectures and solution designs for Microsoft-based business, data and digital workplace solutions.
Lead needs analysis and requirements discussions with business users, IT teams and key stakeholders.
Translate business needs into clear technical requirements, solution options and implementation roadmaps.
Support the implementation and development of solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Fabric.
Establish and improve governance models, operating models and ways of working for Power Platform and related Microsoft services.
Define architecture principles covering security, compliance, integrations, environments, lifecycle management and scalability.
Work with data engineering, BI, data modelling, integrations, AI, information security, data governance and cost management.
Contribute to Azure Landing Zone design and management, including the guardrails needed for secure and scalable workloads.
Support digital workplace initiatives, change management and the adoption of new tools and ways of working.
Produce clear architecture documentation, technical decision records and guidance for development and operational teams.
Work as part of a multidisciplinary consulting team that includes specialists in Azure, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, AI, product ownership, testing and quality assurance.
Support knowledge transfer to the municipality’s internal business and IT teams.

Ideal candidate profile

At least 5 years of experience as a Solution Architect or in an equivalent architecture role focused on Microsoft-based business solutions.
Hands-on experience designing and implementing solutions using Microsoft Power Platform and/or Dynamics 365.
Proven experience leading needs analyses, requirements workshops and stakeholder discussions.
Ability to translate business requirements into clear, practical and scalable technical solutions.
Experience establishing governance models, governance frameworks or operating models for Power Platform or comparable enterprise platforms.
Experience advising organisations on target architectures, digitalisation initiatives or modern business-platform strategy.
Good understanding of Microsoft Azure, cloud architecture and enterprise integration patterns.
Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, data platforms, analytics or related data-management concepts is highly desirable.
Understanding of governance, information security, compliance and cost management in cloud-based environments.
Strong communication, facilitation and documentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with both business and IT stakeholders.
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English
, both written and spoken. Swedish is mandatory because the end client is a Swedish municipality and the role involves close collaboration, requirements work and documentation in a public-sector setting.
Rediness to join the project from October, 19th

Conditions

Location: Tyresö Kommun.
Work model: On-site initially; hybrid work may be possible later.
Workload: Full-time, 100%.
Assignment period: 1 year, with a possibility of extension until October 2030.
Start: October, 19th

jobs.description:
Var med och forma framtidens datadrivna och AI-drivna organisationer

De flesta organisationer ser idag att data och AI är avgörande för framtida konkurrenskraft. Utmaningen är att veta var man ska börja och hur man skapar rätt förutsättningar för att lyckas över tid.

Våra kunder står inför strategiska beslut kring plattformar, arkitektur, styrning och AI-adoption. De beslut som fattas idag kommer att påverka deras förmåga att utveckla verksamheten, skapa innovation och dra nytta av data under många år framöver.

Att fatta rätt beslut från början är avgörande. Fel arkitektur kan bromsa utveckling, öka kostnader och begränsa möjligheten att skapa värde från investeringar i data och AI.

Som Data & AI Architect på Nexer Insight hjälper du kunder att navigera dessa beslut genom att definiera framtida arkitekturer, vägleda teknikval och forma strategiska transformationsinitiativ.

Du kommer att påverka både teknikstrategi, affärsprioriteringar och långsiktig kundframgång samtidigt som du hjälper organisationer att bygga grunden för en datadriven framtid.

Utmaningar du kommer att arbeta med:

Modernisera äldre data- och analysmiljöer
Definiera framtida arkitekturer
Etablera skalbara och säkra plattformar
Säkerställa att teknikinvesteringar stödjer affärsmålen
Skapa de förutsättningar som krävs för AI-adoption

Projekt/arbetsuppgifter du kan bli en del av:

Ta fram strategier för data, analys och AI
Designa arkitekturer baserade på Microsoft Fabric och Databricks
Leda arkitekturworkshops med verksamhets- och teknikledare
Driva större transformationsinitiativ inom dataområdet
Stödja organisationer i arbetet med ansvarsfull AI-adoption

Du kommer att spela en central roll i beslut som påverkar både teknik och affärsutveckling.

Tekniker och plattformar

Microsoft Fabric
Azure
Databricks
Data Governance
Analytics Platforms
AI Services
Enterprise Architecture

Varför Nexer Insight?

Hos oss blir du en del av ett team med arkitekter, data engineers, data scientists och AI-specialister som tillsammans hjälper kunder att lösa komplexa verksamhets- och teknikrelaterade utmaningar.

Du får möjlighet att lära av erfarna kollegor, påverka tekniska beslut och arbeta nära kunder i projekt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.

Du blir en del av ett team vars kompetens har uppmärksammats av Microsoft genom vårt Solutions Partner-status och våra Advanced Specializations inom Analytics på Microsoft Azure samt Data & AI. Det är certifieringar som endast ett fåtal organisationer i Norden har, vilket speglar den erfarenhet, specialistkompetens och leveransförmåga som finns hos våra medarbetare.

Vi är även Databricks Consulting Partner med Select-status, vilket ger oss möjlighet att arbeta nära en av marknadens ledande plattformar för data, analys och AI. För dig innebär det möjligheten att arbeta med moderna teknologier, erfarna specialister och några av marknadens mest spännande data- och AI-initiativ.

Med rötter i svensk entreprenörsanda och innovation har vi hjälpt kunder att ligga steget före sedan internets början – i allt från strategi till teknik och kommunikation.

Idag är vi en betrodd partner för några av världens största och mest krävande organisationer.

Vi hjälper organisationer att omsätta data och AI till mätbart affärsvärde genom att kombinera strategi, styrning, teknik och förändringsledning. På så sätt skapar vi förutsättningar för ansvarsfull AI-adoption, datadrivet beslutsfattande och långsiktig tillväxt.

Moderna dataplattformar och en tung bakgrund inom data engineering

jobs.description:
Vi söker fler Integration & Data‑arkitekter som vill arbeta i miljöer där teknik, verksamhet och säkerhet möts. Hos oss får du arbeta långsiktigt, nära kundens kärnverksamhet - i uppdrag där din expertis gör stor skillnad för både affären och helheten.

Vi erbjuder en trygg och professionell miljö där samarbete, kvalitet och hållbara arbetssätt står i centrum.

Är du den vi söker?

Du trivs i uppdrag där du får:

designa och implementera robusta integrationslösningar
arbeta med modern eventdriven arkitektur
skapa tydliga API-strukturer och flöden som håller över tid
analysera verksamhetsprocesser och omsätta dem i tekniska lösningar
etablera principer, mallar och referensarkitektur
guida team i CI/CD, IaC och goda integrationsmönster

Du behöver inte vara expert på allt - vi söker dig som är trygg, nyfiken och gillar att ta ansvar för helheten.

Arbetsuppgifterna varierar beroende på uppdrag, men kan inkludera:

Integrationsarkitektur

design och implementation i Azure Integration Services
API-design (REST, eventdrivet, hybridlösningar)
patterns för köer, pub/sub, integrationsplattformar och pipelines

Data & Flöden

ETL/ELT, datakvalitet och optimering av dataflöden
analys av systemlandskap och informationsmodeller
monitoreringsstrategier och operational readiness

Dev & CI/CD

CI/CD-relaterat arbete i Azure DevOps
infrastructure as code och automatiserad deployment
teststrategier för integration och flöden

Verksamhetsnära arkitektur

workshops och behovsinsamling
stöd inför upphandlingar och tekniska vägval
affärsförståelse inom energi, bank/finans, industri, offentlig sektor m.m.

Vilka vi tror att du är

Vi tror att du:

gillar att skapa tydlighet i komplexa systemlandskap
har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera tekniska beslut
är trygg i rollen och trivs nära både utveckling och verksamhet
är prestigelös, inkluderande och värdesätter teamets framgång
är nyfiken på nya tekniker och arbetssätt, t.ex. AI‑drivna verktyg
vill arbeta långsiktigt och hållbart, tillsammans med andra

Hos oss behöver du inte passa in i en mall. Vi tror på olika erfarenheter, bakgrunder och perspektiv - och vi vill att du ska kunna växa på det sätt som passar dig.

Trygga uppdrag där din kompetens behövs på riktigt

Som Integration & Data Architect hos oss får du arbeta i uppdrag som är:

affärskritiska – där data och flöden är centrala för verksamheten
långsiktiga – med tid att göra det rätt, inte bara snabbt
moderna – med Azure, moln, automatisering och nya arbetssätt
stabila – med erfarna team och kunder som litar på oss

Vi matchar dig utifrån din kompetens och dina ambitioner — inte mot första lediga uppdrag.

🚀 Vi satsar på dig

Hos oss får du:

kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling och certifieringar
gemenskap och kunskapsdelning genom interna kompetensdagar
möjlighet att påverka teknik, arkitektur och arbetssätt i uppdrag
en kultur av omtanke, kvalitet och nyfikenhet
kollegor som gärna delar med sig, sparrar och stöttar

Tillsammans bygger vi säkra digitala lösningar som skapar värde - för kunden, samhället och framtiden.

jobs.title: Developer Business Central
jobs.description:
Har du ett stort intresse för digitalisering och är redo för din nästa utmaning i karriären? Ser du enorma möjligheter för D365 Business Central och vill vara med och bygga marknadens bästa erbjudande? Då är den här möjligheten helt rätt för dig.

Vad innebär jobbet?

I rollen som Developer Business Central på Accigo kommer du att vara en del av ett snabbväxande och engagerat team. Du kommer att arbeta för att vårt erbjudande inom Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central är det bästa och mest attraktiva på marknaden, både ur ett kund- och medarbetarperspektiv.

Tillsammans med utvecklingsteamet kommer du att utveckla vår affär genom att arbeta nära våra kunder och bygga högt förtroende för våra kunders tekniska lösning samt våra utvecklingsprocesser. Tjänsten ger även stor möjlighet att själv påverka ditt arbete och vad rollen utvecklas till. Det finns möjlighet till att både ta en ledande roll i leverans och fördjupa dig i rollen som utvecklare.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig med ett engagemang som smittar av sig på människor i din omgivning och dig som vill ta nästa steg i din karriär. Rollen som utvecklare hos oss passar dig som brinner för tech och drivs av verksamhetsutveckling, affärssystem och digitalisering. Du gillar att ta dig an problem för att hitta den bästa lösningen tillsammans med teamet.

Du vill alltid leverera maximalt värde ute hos kund och samtidigt vidareutveckla din befintliga kompetens som konsult och som teknisk specialist inom Microsoftplattformen. Du trivs i ett prestigelöst arbetsklimat med högt i tak och där teamet stöttar varandra för att bli framgångsrika.

Vi ser att du

Har några års erfarenhet som utvecklare inom Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
Har deltagit i uppgraderings- och utvecklingsprojekt.
Har förståelse för Microsofts plattform och förstår hur det kan nyttjas ur ett affärsperspektiv.
Rör dig bekvämt i både i SaaS och on-prem miljöer.
Behärskar den senaste tekniken (Visual Studio Code AL-språket, Extensions, DevOps, Power Platform).
Kan påvisa tidigare erfarenhet där ditt arbete bidragit till att utveckla affären och/eller teamet
Trivs i eller är nyfiken på hur det är att arbeta i en entreprenöriell miljö där du kan vara med och utveckla
Har ambition att ta en ledande roll i leverans.

Meriterande

Innehar certifieringen Dynamics 365 Business Central Developer Associate

Teamet Business Central

Teamet Business Central ingår i Accigos största affärsområde Business Applications där vi hjälper våra kunder att modernisera och utveckla verksamhetskritiska processer inom ekonomi, logistik och verksamhetsstyrning. Genom Microsoft Dynamics 365, data och AI skapar vi smartare arbetsflöden, bättre beslutsstöd och ökad effektivitet. Vi kombinerar affärsförståelse, teknik och innovation för att hjälpa organisationer att växa, anpassa sig och skapa långsiktigt affärsvärde.

Vi utmärker oss med en unik företagskultur som värdesätter samarbete, innovation och personlig utveckling. Detta avspeglar sig hos både de medarbetare och kunder som väljer oss, vilket ger en dynamisk och rolig vardag. Vi kallar det Business Wellness.

Accigo är en av få partners i Sverige med djup kompetens över hela Microsofts plattform (bl.a. Dynamics Partner of the Year 2024, CoPilot Jumpstart, Global AI Council etc) och kan skapa de mest innovativa och optimerade helhetslösningarna. Tillsammans med vårt systerbolag Centigo är vi en uppskattad strategisk partner för digitalt driven affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling och får naturligt en bra förankring i högsta ledningen hos våra kunder. På så sätt kan vi skapa förändring på riktigt.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Nyfiken?
Vi svarar gärna på frågor, eller berättar mer om oss över en kaffe - du kan enkelt komma i kontakt med oss: Amir.hosseini@accigo.se

Läs gärna mer om oss och träffa våra medarbetare på vår karriärsida: https://karriar.accigo.se/

Vi utvärderar ansökningar löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka din ansökan.

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

jobs.title: Experienced Software Engineer – Imaging Tools & Test Automation
jobs.description:
Job Title

Experienced Software Engineer – Imaging Tools & Test Automation

Job Description

Do you enjoy building the tools that other engineers depend on? Join our imaging laboratory team in Lund as an Experienced Software Engineer – Imaging Tools & Automation, and help shape the environment behind the best forensic image quality on the market.

Who is your future team?

You will join the imaging laboratory team in Lund, responsible for developing and maintaining the internal tools used by Axis imaging engineers. The team takes strong ownership of its service — a service that plays an essential role in delivering the best forensic image quality on the market.

You will belong to the software part of the group, working alongside colleagues on the hardware side.

What you'll do here as Experienced Software Engineer – Imaging Tools & Test Automation

This role exists to support our imaging engineers by maintaining and developing the frontend and backend of the imaging lab interface. The scope extends to any tooling or automation that improves the quality and efficiency of imaging development work.

Are you ready to shape the next generation of connected vehicle data platforms and B2B services? We are seeking a driven and experienced Software Engineer to take end-to-end ownership in building secure, scalable, and high-performing microservices and management portals.

In this role, you will develop and maintain backend services, microservices, and REST APIs for external vehicle data and B2B platform services. You will build core platform capabilities across authentication, authorization, tenant and user management, vehicle management, subscriptions, entitlements, usage metering, billing support, and service monitoring.

Working closely with data engineers, product owners, and architects, you will translate business requirements into scalable and user-friendly technical solutions. You will participate in the full software development lifecycle—from solution design and API contracts to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, production deployment, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities & Key Duties

Design, build, and maintain microservices, REST APIs, and secure integration patterns to expose vehicle data products to external customers, partners, and third-party platforms.
Implement features for OAuth 2.0/OIDC, system-to-system authentication, tenant management, user management, subscriptions, entitlements, and usage metering.
Develop and maintain the platform management portal as well as customer-facing web pages for service onboarding, API documentation, data product discovery, subscription management, usage visibility, and service status.
Integrate internal data pipelines into secure external services and customer-facing applications. Support integrations with external partner platforms and cloud environments (such as AWS and Alibaba Cloud).
Implement logging, monitoring, alerting, tracing, and health checks across APIs, microservices, frontends, and platform integrations. Ensure software quality via unit, integration, API, UI, and regression testing.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing workflows, and release verification. Troubleshoot complex issues across backend, frontend, APIs, deployments, and cloud environments. Guide external customer and partner onboarding with API documentation and secure access setup.
3–5 years of professional experience in software engineering, backend development, full-stack development, or a related field.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong programming experience in at least one of the following: Java, Python, Go, or Node.js. Solid understanding of microservice architecture, service boundaries, API contracts, integration patterns, and distributed systems.
Practical experience with authentication and authorization standards, preferably OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and system-to-system integration patterns.
Experience developing or maintaining frontend applications using modern web technologies such as React, Angular, or Vue.js, along with TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Hands-on experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases. Familiarity with cloud platforms (preferably AWS, including services such as API Gateway, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, or equivalent).
Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (unit, integration, API, UI, regression), and observability tools.
Language: Professional fluency in English (both spoken and written).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in automotive B2B domain or data sharing products (e.g., Data Act compliance), subscription-based services, tenant management, customer portals, or data products.
Experience integrating with external platforms or cloud environments such as Alibaba Cloud or Azure.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Bygg dataplattformarna som möjliggör nästa generations AI

AI förändrar hur organisationer arbetar, fattar beslut och skapar värde, samtidigt som företag i allt högre grad investerar i data, analys och AI för att stärka sin konkurrenskraft och skapa nya affärsmöjligheter.

Trots detta har många organisationer fortfarande svårt att realisera det fulla värdet av sina investeringar. Data är ofta utspridd i flera system, äldre plattformar begränsar utvecklingen och bristande struktur gör det utmanande att skala analys- och AI-initiativ.

Därför söker våra kunder nya sätt att modernisera sina dataplattformar, säkerställa tillgång till tillförlitlig data och bygga de förutsättningar som krävs för att lyckas med framtidens analys- och AI-satsningar.

Som Data Engineer på Nexer Insight hjälper du våra kunder att lösa dessa utmaningar genom att designa och bygga moderna dataplattformar som möjliggör affärskritiska beslut, avancerad analys och AI-lösningar.

Ditt arbete bidrar till hur organisationer använder sin data, accelererar sin AI-adoption och skapar mätbart affärsvärde.

Utmaningar du kommer att arbeta med
:
Modernisera befintliga dataplattformar
Skapa skalbara och tillförlitliga datagrunder
Förbättra datakvalitet och styrning
Möjliggöra avancerad analys och rapportering
Bygga de förutsättningar som krävs för AI-adoption

Projekt/arbetsuppgifter du kan bli en del av:

Bygga Microsoft Fabric-plattformar för globala verksamheter
Designa moderna lakehouse-arkitekturer med Azure och Databricks
Utveckla datapipelines som stödjer AI- och Machine Learning-initiativ
Möjliggöra realtidsanalys för affärskritiska verksamheter
Skapa de datagrunder som krävs för Generativ AI

Inget projekt är det andra likt. Du kommer att arbeta med kunder i olika branscher där data är en central strategisk tillgång som driver insikter, beslut och utveckling.

Tekniker och plattformar du kan komma att arbeta med:

Microsoft Fabric
Azure Data Factory
Azure Data Lake
Databricks
SQL
Python
Power BI
Git och CI/CD

Varför Nexer Insight?

Hos oss blir du en del av ett team med arkitekter, data engineers, data scientists och AI-specialister som tillsammans hjälper kunder att lösa komplexa verksamhets- och teknikrelaterade utmaningar.

Du får möjlighet att lära av erfarna kollegor, påverka tekniska beslut och arbeta nära kunder i projekt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.

Du blir en del av ett team vars kompetens har uppmärksammats av Microsoft genom vårt Solutions Partner-status och våra Advanced Specializations inom Analytics på Microsoft Azure samt Data & AI. Det är certifieringar som endast ett fåtal organisationer i Norden har, vilket speglar den erfarenhet, specialistkompetens och leveransförmåga som finns hos våra medarbetare.

Vi är även Databricks Consulting Partner med Select-status, vilket ger oss möjlighet att arbeta nära en av marknadens ledande plattformar för data, analys och AI. För dig innebär det möjligheten att arbeta med moderna teknologier, erfarna specialister och några av marknadens mest spännande data- och AI-initiativ.

Med rötter i svensk entreprenörsanda och innovation har vi hjälpt kunder att ligga steget före sedan internets början – i allt från strategi till teknik och kommunikation.

Idag är vi en betrodd partner för några av världens största och mest krävande organisationer.

Vi hjälper organisationer att omsätta data och AI till mätbart affärsvärde genom att kombinera strategi, styrning, teknik och förändringsledning. På så sätt skapar vi förutsättningar för ansvarsfull AI-adoption, datadrivet beslutsfattande och långsiktig tillväxt.

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du har erfarenhet av:

Minimum 6–10 års erfarenhet inom Data Engineering
Att bygga och utveckla moderna dataplattformar
Molnplattformar som Azure, AWS eller GCP
SQL och arbete med stora datamängder
ETL- och ELT-processer
Svenska och engelska flytande i tal och skrift

Meriterande erfarenheter

Microsoft Fabric
Databricks
Data Vault
DAX och Tabular Models
Lakehouse-arkitektur
Snowflake
DBT
DevOps, Git och CI/CD

Vill du vara med och bygga dataplattformarna som möjliggör nästa generations AI-lösningar?

Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.

SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.

Job Title
: Senior Software Developer (C#)

Location
: Ireland, Galway - Hybrid

Role Type
: Permanent, Full Time

Who We Are

At SOTI, we are committed to delivering best in class mobile and IoT device management solutions. We are looking for out of the box thinkers that appreciate the art of creating great software. To us, being visionary is more important than doing things the way they’ve always been done.

What We’re Looking For

Our people are our most important resource. For us to continue to develop new innovations and achieve the impossible, we are looking for out-of-the-box thinkers that appreciate the art of creating great software.

As the successful candidate, you have strong math and logical thinking, excellent understanding of algorithms, data structures, software architecture and design, and you understand the logic behind how things work.

We are looking for innovative Senior Software Development professionals with strong previous experience with back-end and front-end technologies. You are excited to work shoulder to shoulder with talented, fun-loving team breaking down complex problems into simple solutions. You will be able to take part in brainstorming and bringing new ideas to the table, which will be rewarded by your professional growth and motivating career advancement with SOTI.

What’s in it for you?

The People
- From our humble origins in our founder’s basement, to our industry-leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation and fun.

The Growth
- Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the finish line. At SOTI, we have a fast-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big!

The Technology
- You’ll get the chance to work with leading-edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects, as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners, including some leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies.

What You'll Do

Design, develop, test and deploy complex product modules on time
End-to-end ownership of the assigned modules with a strong focus on the solution, code quality, performance, security and efficiency
Actively contribute toward design discussions
Demonstrate engineering excellence through commitment to quality execution, continuous improvement and customer empathy
Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices such as style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability and efficiency
Provide solid technical leadership and work closely with team leads, product management and QA teams for flawless delivery of the product
Actively contribute towards the CICD process
Drive team in adopting relevant new technologies, tools, methods and processes
Mentor and train junior team members on design techniques and coding standards
Propose innovative solutions to address business problems
Maintain high-quality standards on all deliverables
Proactively identify and work on automation opportunities
Conduct training and resource onboarding sessions

Experience You'll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a STEM-related field, with strong communication skills and a solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and design patterns, as well as the underlying logic and relationships within software systems.
Proven hands-on experience in software development and solution design, preferably within product-based organizations, with 8+ years of enterprise-level development experience.
Expertise in C#, .NET (ASP.NET MVC, WebAPI 2.0, Threading), REST APIs, JSON and SQL server.
A plus to have experience with: modern front-end technologies, such as JavaScript/ Typescript, Angular 21, HTML5, SCSS, and NGRX
Independently write code, unit test cases, BDD and automation scripts.
Excellent understanding of unit test principles, multi-layer architecture, SOA principles and best development practices
A broad experience of architecture, infrastructure, software, and computing systems with a proven track record of designing and developing solutions for end users on cross platform systems.
Passion for modern technology and a proven track record of successfully making a positive impact as tech visionary.
Understanding/or strong interest in Agile methods such as Scrum/XP, Behavior Driven Development, and Continuous Delivery
Eagerness to constantly learn and update your skills, and you like to share knowledge with others. 
Self-starter attitude with a high degree of initiative and a positive mindset

About SOTI

SOTI is the world's most trusted provider of mobile and IoT management solutions, with more than 17,000 enterprise customers and millions of devices managed worldwide. SOTI's innovative portfolio of solutions and services provide the tools organizations need to truly mobilize their operations and optimize their mobility investments. SOTI extends secure mobility management to provide a total, flexible solution for comprehensive management and security of all mobile devices and connected peripherals deployed in an organization.

At SOTI, we celebrate the uniqueness of our global teams and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are curious problem solvers who are committed to bringing the best mobile and IoT management solutions to market. We offer careers with #EndlessPossibilities.

What are you waiting for? Apply today: https://www.soti.net/careers

If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

jobs.title: Digital Solution Engineer - Azure Platform, French Speaking
jobs.description:
Overview

Azure is a $100B business growing at more than 40% year over year at Microsoft — and application modernization is one of the largest driver of that growth. Customers are no longer asking whether to move to the cloud; they are asking which Azure destination is right for each application, and how fast they can get there. That decision is where you come in.

Are you curious, passionate about infrastructure and applications, and ready to solve complex modernization challenges in the AI era? Join us as a Digital Solution Engineer – Azure Platform, supporting mid-market customers across the Azure application and data platform.

In this technical sales role, you will help customers move beyond lift-and-shift and re-platform their application estate onto the best-fit Azure destination — Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, or Azure Kubernetes Service — backed by the right data platform, whether that is Azure SQL or an open-source engine such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. You will translate architectural choices into business outcomes: lower run cost, faster release cadence, stronger security posture, and an application estate that is ready for AI.

About SME&C

At Small, Medium Enterprises and Channel (SME&C), we are leading a high-growth, AI-powered global sales team — one that is deeply connected to our partners and driven by customer success. By uniting our Small Medium Business, Corporate, Strategy, and Partner teams, we are unlocking the largest customer opportunity, backed by the industry’s most significant investments. Leveraging the power of AI and our extensive partner ecosystem, we are redefining how businesses of all sizes adopt technology to drive growth and innovation.

SME&C is more than a sales organization — it’s a culture of innovation, opportunity, and inclusivity. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, high-performing, and customer-obsessed team where collaboration, connection, and continuous learning fuel everything we do. If you thrive in a fast-paced, digital-first environment and are eager to make a meaningful impact, explore how SME&C can be the next step in your career.

The Core of the Role: Driving Application Modernization

The defining capability of this role is your ability to take a customer’s existing application portfolio and drive it to the most appropriate Azure destination — on both the application and the data tier. This is a judgment-led discipline, not a template. You are expected to assess each workload on its operational model, scale profile, cost envelope, compliance constraints, and the customer’s developer velocity, then recommend and defend the right landing zone.

Application platform destinations

You Are Fluent Across The Full Azure Application Platform And Can Articulate — With Credibility, In Front Of Architects — When To Choose Each

Azure App Service — for web apps and APIs that benefit from a fully managed PaaS runtime with minimal operational overhead; the fastest path off Windows/IIS and Java/Tomcat estates.
Azure Container Apps — for containerized microservices, event-driven workloads, and scale-to-zero scenarios where teams want containers without owning a cluster.
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) — for complex, large-scale, or portability-driven estates that require full orchestration control, custom networking, and platform-engineering maturity.
Azure Functions, Azure Arc, and Azure VMs — as complementary destinations for event-driven code, hybrid and edge estates, and workloads that are expected to remain IaaS in the near term.

Critically, you can explain the trade-offs between these destinations rather than defaulting to one — including the cost, operational, and skills implications of each choice, and the containerization and refactoring path required to get there.

Data platform destinations

Modernizing The Application Without Modernizing The Data Tier Leaves Most Of The Value On The Table. You Bring Equal Depth Across The Azure Database Estate

Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance — for modernizing SQL Server estates to PaaS, including compatibility assessment, Hyperscale, and Business Critical tiering.
SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines — where full instance control or third-party dependencies require IaaS, with a defined path to PaaS over time.
Azure Database for PostgreSQL (Flexible Server) — including Oracle-to-PostgreSQL modernization and PostgreSQL as the default open-source landing zone for new and refactored applications.
Azure Database for MySQL (Flexible Server) — for LAMP-stack and ISV application estates moving off self-managed MySQL or MariaDB.
Azure Cosmos DB — including the MongoDB (vCore) and PostgreSQL APIs, for globally distributed, high-throughput, and NoSQL workloads.

You are comfortable leading open-source database conversations on their own merits — licensing economics, extension compatibility, high availability, and migration tooling — and can run an Oracle, MongoDB, or self-managed PostgreSQL/MySQL modernization conversation end to end.

Modernization method

Lead portfolio-level assessment and apply the 6R framework (rehost, replatform, refactor, rearchitect, rebuild, replace) to segment an estate and sequence the work.
Apply containerization and refactoring leading practices, and use AI and intelligent agents to accelerate legacy code assessment, dependency mapping, and transformation.
Design the surrounding architecture — hybrid and cloud-native networking, virtual networks, private connectivity, secure routing, identity, and landing-zone design — so modernized applications meet enterprise performance and compliance requirements.
Complement Microsoft technology with trusted partner solutions such as NetApp, VMware, Red Hat, and SAP to deliver a secure, optimized, and scalable migration experience.
Ground every recommendation in Azure security services and compliance frameworks, so customers meet regulatory requirements and build a cloud estate that is ready for what comes next.

This Opportunity Will Allow You To

Accelerate your career growth by leading the modernization engagements that sit at the centre of a $100M, +40% YoY growth business.
Deepen your technical proficiency through hands-on architecture design, application and database migration planning, and implementation of hybrid and cloud-native environments.
Develop strategic influence by shaping the destination decisions — App Service, Container Apps, AKS, Azure SQL, or open-source databases — that determine a customer’s cost base and agility for years.
Strengthen your collaboration skills by working closely with engineering teams, partners, and customer stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.
Build future-ready capabilities through continuous learning, industry-recognized certifications, and exposure to Microsoft’s evolving application, data, security, and AI platform.

Responsibilities

Drive technical sales using architecture design sessions, technical demos, proofs of concept, and modernization accelerators to influence solution design and unblock deployment.
Own the destination recommendation — assess customer application portfolios and recommend the best-fit Azure application and data platform target, with a defensible rationale on cost, scale, operations, and developer velocity.
Lead application modernization workshops and migration assessments spanning App Service, Container Apps, AKS, Azure SQL, and open-source database options.
Build trusted relationships with platform leads, application owners, and data teams to co-design secure, scalable, and cost-efficient solutions.
Resolve technical blockers by collaborating with engineering, partners, and product teams, and channel customer insight back into the product.
Maintain deep expertise across cloud migration and modernization — Windows, Linux, .NET, Java, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and containerized workloads — alongside resiliency, security, and compliance.
Deepen knowledge of enterprise applications (SAP, Oracle) and Azure VMware Solution (AVS) as adjacent modernization paths.
Represent Microsoft in customer forums and technical communities through thought leadership on application and data modernization.

Qualifications

Extensive technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience
OR Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND demonstrated technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience
OR Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND demonstrated technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience
OR equivalent experience
Proven experience driving application modernization to cloud platforms, including migration and replatforming of workloads such as Windows, Linux, .NET, Java, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL.
Hands-on experience with managed application platforms and container services — Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) — and with containerization strategy.
Demonstrated database modernization experience across both commercial and open-source engines (SQL Server / Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and NoSQL options).
Experience designing or selling solutions involving hybrid networking, secure connectivity, or network performance optimization in enterprise environments.
Advanced understanding of Azure services, including security, compliance, and hybrid cloud scenarios.
Ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders to design and deploy scalable, secure cloud solutions.

jobs.title: Director Digital Platform
jobs.description:
At Bulk, our mission is to build sustainable infrastructure that supports the digital society of tomorrow. As one of the leading providers of sustainable, high-performance data center solutions in the Nordics, we design and operate infrastructure that powers artificial intelligence and the digital society – efficiently, securely, and with 100% renewable energy. We are now looking to hire a Director of Digital Platform to play a central role in building the data and software platform that our AI and digital ambitions rest on.

Bulk's AI & Digital function exists to leverage AI and digital to improve operations, save costs, and automate work. You will own the foundation the rest of it builds on, both its architecture and its build: the data-and-software platform behind every product surface and every AI agent on the team. You will stand up the data layer: live readings off Bulk's data center sites, data from the core business systems, and integrations with partner and OEM digital offerings, plus the interfaces that let AI agents act safely and the developer tooling the team relies on.

Reporting to the VP AI & Digital, you will ship in thin slices, own the build-versus-buy calls, enforce governance at the interface layer alongside Cyber Security, and lead the platform team hands-on, staying close to the code.

What you'll do:

As our Director Digital Platform, your key responsibilities will be:

Platform and data

Stand up the platform that pulls live readings off the data center sites and turns that data into something the rest of the team can build on.
Ship in thin slices, starting with one site, one use case, one connector.
Integrate data from core business systems such as ERP and CRM, in close collaboration with IT, who run, maintain and upgrade them.
Connect partner and OEM digital offerings so their data and capabilities are available through the platform.

Architecture and technology choices

Own the platform architecture: how the layers fit together, what the interfaces look like, and how it holds up as Bulk goes from one site to many.
Own the build-versus-buy decisions on the platform layer, and coordinate with existing systems vendors so the team doesn't duplicate what is already there.
Take a position on the platform's cloud direction and keep the cost of running it under control as it grows.

Interfaces, governance and security

Design the interface layer as the place the rules are enforced: who can log in, what gets recorded, rate limits, and who is allowed to see which data.
Partner with Cyber Security so the controls on platform data and access are designed in, not reviewed after.
Deliver interfaces for customers and partners to pull relevant live data, service-level status and incident events.

Team and ways of working

Build and lead a focused platform team, including DevOps , backend development, and data product development, with consultants brought in for surge work.
Run the sandbox where colleagues across Bulk prototype and prove ideas safely and own the engineer-led path that promotes a proven proof of concept into production.
Work closely with the program leads for operations, projects and the commercial side, who will build on the platform you own.

Who are you?

You are a hands-on engineering leader who stays close to the code rather than managing from a distance. You are pragmatic about scope and ship working slices, not cathedrals. Your technical judgment is strong, you make architectural calls and own them, and you de-risk with smaller initiatives while keeping the bigger picture in mind. You are fluent in a modern engineering toolchain and in agentic workflows, infrastructure included, and you get far more out of a small team because of it. In a function that is still taking shape, you find your own way, stay curious, take up space, and carry things through.

What you bring:

Minimum 10 years in software engineering and technology, and still hands-on. You read, write and review code fluently, and architecture and delivery calls are made from inside the code, not above it.
Proven experience standing up an industrial IoT platform in an industrial enterprise, in production, not designed on paper.
Strong working command of a modern cloud platform, Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, as someone who builds on it rather than buys it: networking, identity, data services and cost control.
Experience integrating core business systems such as ERP and CRM, alongside the IT organization that runs them.
Experience standing up and running infrastructure with agentic tooling, including AgentOps: operating the platform through agents, not only writing code with their help.
Experience leading a small, senior engineering team while staying close to the code.
Good understanding of OT systems and the protocols the data comes over, such as SCADA, building management systems, OPC UA, Modbus and MQTT. Familiarity with data center, energy or other physical infrastructure environments is an advantage.
Higher education in engineering, computer science or a related technical discipline. Extensive relevant experience may compensate for formal education.
Excellent communication skills in English; proficiency in a Scandinavian language is considered an advantage.

Why join us?

Build Bulk's digital platform from the ground up, and the team around it.
Influence how key operational processes are shaped and developed.
Become part of a growing organization with a strong sustainability mission.
Work with critical infrastructure that supports the digital society of tomorrow.
Collaborate with highly skilled colleagues across disciplines and locations.

What we offer our Bulkies:

A dynamic, growth-oriented workplace with a strong sustainability focus
Comprehensive insurance (health, travel – business & private) and annual health check
Additional time off during Easter and Christmas
Monthly contribution to home internet costs and sustainable commuting
Annual wellness allowance to support an active lifestyle
Fully paid parental leave

Take the next step in your career and join us as we build the future of digital infrastructure in Norway and beyond!

Next steps

We review applicants continuously, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. To apply, please upload your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are the ideal candidate for this role.

We conduct background checks on all hires. We may also require you to obtain security clearance and a police certificate of conduct.

Bulk aim for gender balance and a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate against gender, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy and/or disability. We appreciate the time you have spent reading this, and if the role aligns with your aspirations, we encourage you to apply!

Racing to bring sustainable infrastructure to a global audience!
We are a leading Nordic developer of digital infrastructure. Bulk develops data centers and fiber networks that serves as the backbone of our digital society.

Bulk Infrastructure is a leading Nordic provider of sustainable digital infrastructure, specializing in data centers, fiber networks, and industrial real estate. Founded with a long-term vision, our founder remains a key owner
, ensuring continuity and commitment to our mission. We are also backed by BGO
, a global real estate investment management firm known for its expertise and leadership in the industry. Supported by a strong management team, solid ownership and delivered by a dedicated Team Bulk
– we build something bigger than ourselves.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Base360.ai
is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for a highly ambitious Senior Software Engineer
who wants to build systems that solve real problems at scale. You'll build, ship, automate, and deliver products that directly impact property managers, their teams, and their guests.

If you're excited by APIs, automation, AI agents, cloud infrastructure, and building products from the ground up, we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll help architect and scale Base360.ai—the platform powering every aspect of a short-term rental business.

You'll build customer-facing products, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, integrations, and operational systems that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will span the entire short-term rental lifecycle: from listing distribution, pricing, and bookings to guest stays, property operations, and financial reporting.

Your Mission

Build the Core Platform

Design and develop scalable applications, services, and APIs that power reservations, availability, pricing, payments, guest experiences, and property operations.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Systems

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Design API-First Architecture

Create robust APIs that connect internal services, booking channels, third-party providers, and customer systems.

Integrate the Ecosystem

Build and maintain integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other strategic partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Scale Infrastructure

Deploy and manage cloud-native infrastructure designed for reliability, performance, and global growth across multiple property management businesses.

Solve Complex Operational Problems

Build Solutions For

Real-time reservation and availability synchronization
Dynamic pricing intelligence
Smart lock access and key management
Automated guest communication across channels
Operational forecasting
Cleaning and maintenance automation
Owner reporting and financial workflows
AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Move Fast and Own Delivery

Own projects end-to-end—from understanding an operator’s problem to architecture, implementation, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

Bring senior engineering judgment to technical decisions, code reviews, and the reliability of the systems you build.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

Python
FastAPI
React
TypeScript
Supabase
PostgreSQL
AWS
Serverless architecture
OpenAI APIs
Twilio
Stripe
Docker
GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

Strong experience building and owning production-grade software systems
Experience with FastAPI, Python, React, or similar frameworks
Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, and cloud architecture
Experience designing scalable backend systems and reliable data models
The ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions
Strong problem-solving skills and a product mindset
Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency
A bias toward action, shipping, and learning from real users
The ability to balance delivery speed with maintainability and reliability

Bonus Points For Experience With

Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems
Multi-tenant SaaS platforms
Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations
AI agents and workflow automation
Event-driven architectures
Supabase
AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First 12 Months

Core short-term rental workflows are automated through systems you've built
Property managers spend less time on manual administration
Reservations, availability, payments, and operational data move reliably between systems
New integrations are deployed and maintained reliably
AI-powered workflows become part of customers’ everyday operations
The platform supports more operators and properties while maintaining reliability and performance
Base360.ai helps customers grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Extreme Ownership

Have the freedom and responsibility to make technical decisions and deliver systems that matter.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment
You prefer a narrowly defined role with limited product involvement
You need detailed instructions for every task
You avoid ownership and accountability
You're comfortable shipping work without taking responsibility for its quality

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

jobs.description:
About The Role

At If Insurance, we are scaling Agentic AI into everyday operations to support our employees and customers. Our AIKA Squad, part of the Intelligent Automation Enabler, develops and operates AI agents and agent platforms that help automate business processes across the If organization.

We are now looking for experienced Agentic AI Developers who can combine strong software and AI engineering skills with hands-on experience in the n8n AI workflow automation platform.

In this role, you will develop capabilities for our AIKA Agent platform and build end-to-end AI-enabled workflows with n8n. You will connect agents, business systems, data sources and human decision points into secure, reliable production solutions.

If you are excited about LLMs, agentic systems, workflow automation, enterprise-grade architecture and turning AI into tangible business value, you will feel at home with us.

You Will

Design, build and operate AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, using tools and collaborating with other agents
Build end-to-end AI-enabled workflows using n8n
Develop reusable capabilities and integrations for our AIKA Agent platform
Connect AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, data sources and business processes
Design workflows that integrate deterministic automation, such as RPA, with generative AI and human decision-making
Implement robust evaluation, tracing, monitoring, error handling and safety controls
Apply secure engineering practices to credentials, identities, data access and integrations
Work closely with business teams to take use cases from initial idea to production
Contribute to shared development standards, reusable components and platform governance

We offer

Benefits

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

An inclucive work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits
Lunch benefit

About The Team

You’ll be working at the heart of If, collaborating across all If countries, Business Areas, Tribes, and Squads, as well as with the whole IT organization.

Our international Intelligent Automation unit consists of skilled professionals across six locations: Espoo, Turku, Copenhagen, Riga, Vilnius, and Kuala Lumpur. We have already successfully scaled RPA as well as Generative AI assistants across the company and are now on track with Agentic AI journey. We take pride in our supportive culture, modern tooling, and the real opportunities for growth in this high-impact domain.

Who are you?

You are a pragmatic software engineer with a strong interest in Agentic AI and intelligent workflow automation. You enjoy solving complex problems by combining AI models, software components, APIs and business systems into reliable end-to-end solutions.

You balance experimentation with engineering discipline, security and operational reliability. You are comfortable taking ownership, collaborating across organizational boundaries and working hands-on with solutions that run in production.

You do not need to be an AI researcher. We are looking for an engineer who enjoys building dependable systems that create measurable value.

You Have Experience Of

Agent & LLM Development

Designing and building production workflows with n8n
Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI
LLM orchestration (agents, tools, function calling, routing, planners)
Familiarity with evaluation and observability tools for LLM systems

Microsoft & Cloud

Azure AI / MS Foundry
Microsoft Agent Framework (or similar agent frameworks)
Azure services: Functions, App Services, Storage, Key Vault, Event Grid, API Management
Networking, identity and access using Entra ID

Software Engineering

C# (.NET), TypeScript/React, or Python (ideally more than one)
CI/CD with Azure DevOps
Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or Bicep)
Designing reliable cloud-native applications and integrations
MCP-based tool and system integration
LLM supported development tools like GitHub Copilot

Additional facts And The Recruitment Process

Application deadline:
 Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is October 7, 2026.

To apply for the position:
 Please attach your CV and answer the questions in the recruiting system.

Work location:
 Even though the majority of the team is located in Turku, the position is open in Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen, Espoo and Turku.

Travelling:
 Some travelling in the Nordic countries is required.

Start:
 As soon as possible/by agreement.

For more information, please contact Asko Mustonen, Head of Intelligent Automation (asko.mustonen@if.fi)

Background checks will be done in accordance with the law in the country of employment.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.description:
As of 2 September 2025, Vivicta, former Tietoevry Tech Services, now operates as a standalone company under our new brand. We’ve officially launched Vivicta, your trusted Nordic transformation partner, making everyday easier through technology. You can explore more about our brand and what we stand for at https://www.vivicta.com

Ready to join us? Click ‘Apply’ and complete our short application form to get started. Prefer another option? Apply via LinkedIn to automatically populate your details using your profile.

Ratkaisuarkkitehti vastaa liiketoiminnan tarpeisiin sopivien teknisten ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja määrittelystä Microsoft Power Platform-, Azure- ja tekoälyympäristöissä. Hän varmistaa, että ratkaisut muodostavat toimivan, turvallisen ja ylläpidettävän kokonaisuuden, joka tukee organisaation tavoitteita sekä nykyisiä että tulevia tarpeita.

Roolissa yhdistyvät tekninen osaaminen, kokonaisuuksien hahmottaminen ja kyky tehdä yhteistyötä niin liiketoiminnan kuin teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Ratkaisuarkkitehti toimii siltana liiketoiminnan tavoitteiden ja käytännön toteutuksen välillä.

Etsimme ratkaisuarkkitehtia, joka pystyy yhdistämään liiketoiminnan tavoitteet, teknologian mahdollisuudet ja toteutuksen käytännön vaatimukset toimivaksi kokonaisuudeksi. Henkilöllä on kokemusta laajojen sovellus- ja integraatioratkaisujen suunnittelusta sekä kyky ohjata kehitystä arkkitehtuurin näkökulmasta koko ratkaisun elinkaaren ajan.

Menestyt roolissa, jos hahmotat kokonaisuuksia nopeasti, osaat tehdä perusteltuja teknisiä valintoja ja pystyt viestimään ne selkeästi sekä kehittäjille että liiketoiminnan edustajille. Lisäksi ymmärrät, miten pilvipalvelut, automaatio ja tekoäly voidaan yhdistää hallituksi ja liiketoimintaa tukevaksi ratkaisuksi.

Keskeiset tehtävät

Suunnitella liiketoiminnan tarpeita tukevia sovellus-, integraatio- ja tekoälyratkaisuja.
Määritellä ratkaisun rakenne, keskeiset komponentit, tietovirrat ja eri järjestelmien väliset riippuvuudet.
Vastata ratkaisujen hallittavuuteen, tietoturvaan, suorituskykyyn ja muihin ei-toiminnallisiin vaatimuksiin liittyvistä linjauksista.
Ohjata kehitystiimejä teknisissä ratkaisuissa ja tukea toteutuksen onnistumista koko projektin ajan.
Määritellä sovelluskehityksen hallintamalleja, ympäristöstrategioita sekä käyttöönotto- ja ylläpitokäytäntöjä.
Arvioida ja suunnitella tekoälyn hyödyntämistä osana liiketoimintaprosesseja ja digitaalisia palveluja.
Kuvata ja esitellä ratkaisuvaihtoehtoja eri sidosryhmille ymmärrettävästi.

Osaamisvaatimukset

Kokemusta Microsoft Power Platform -ratkaisujen ja pilvipalveluiden arkkitehtuurisuunnittelusta.
Ymmärrys sovelluskehityksen elinkaaren hallinnasta, DevOps-toimintatavoista ja ympäristöjen hallinnasta.
Kokemusta yritysratkaisujen integraatioarkkitehtuureista ja järjestelmien yhteentoimivuuden suunnittelusta.
Kyky määritellä tietoturvaan, käyttöoikeuksiin, tietosuojaan ja hallintamalleihin liittyviä ratkaisuja.
Kokemusta tekoäly- ja automaatioratkaisujen hyödyntämisestä osana laajempia liiketoimintaratkaisuja.
Ymmärrys käyttäjäkeskeisestä suunnittelusta ja kyky huomioida loppukäyttäjän tarpeet ratkaisujen suunnittelussa.
Erinomaiset vuorovaikutus- ja fasilitointitaidot sekä kyky kommunikoida teknisiä ratkaisuja erilaisille kohderyhmille.
Käytännön kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä ja modernien kehitysvälineiden hyödyntämisestä.

Teknologiat ja menetelmät

Microsoft Power Platform
Service Bus
Dataverse
API-ratkaisut
Power Apps
PCF-komponentit
Power Automate
LLM-rajapinnat
Copilot Studio
Vektoritietokannat
Azure
ALM ja ympäristöstrategia
Azure DevOps
DLP, tietoturva ja käyttöoikeuksien hallinta
Azure Logic Apps
Conversational design ja AI-agenttien ratkaisumallit

Tarjoamme sinulle

Uramahdollisuuksia ja kehittymistä: osana tiimiämme pääset kehittämään osaamistasi jatkuvasti ja pysymään älykkään automaation alan kehityksen kärjessä.
Merkityksellisiä projekteja: projektimme luovat todellista vaikutusta. Autamme suurimpia yrityksiä hyödyntämään dataa tehokkaammin, ja sinulla on mahdollisuus olla mukana kehittämässä kokonaisia liiketoiminta-alueita.
Huippuosaajien tiimin: voimme ylpeänä sanoa rakentaneemme poikkeuksellisen vahvan asiantuntijayhteisön, jossa jokaisen osaaminen täydentää toisiaan ja yhdessä saavutamme enemmän.
Joustavat työskentelytavat: tarjoamme joustavuutta työn tekemiseen juuri sinulle sopivalla tavalla. Työskentelemme joustavalla hybridityömallilla.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Web Platform
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are hiring for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Web Platform team here at Unity. Unity's Web platform lets games and real-time 3D content run in a browser, on any internet connected device. Browser capability has moved fast, browser gaming is going through a revival, and the Unity Web runtime is what makes it possible. Our work also supports an exciting new partnership with a major platform, which puts what this team builds in front of audiences at a scale few browser platforms reach.

In this role, you will own meaningful areas of the runtime outright. This is not website development. We embed Unity inside the browser, and the problems are the deep ones: making a single-threaded platform multi-threaded, cutting megabytes out of a build, getting a game playable in seconds rather than minutes. You will work alongside engineers who helped invent the browser technology we build on, and you will help the people around you grow.

What You'll Be Doing

Own meaningful areas of the Unity Web runtime, from design through to release
Research, design and implement optimizations to the Web build target, such as stripping unused code from builds and progressively loading assets as a game needs them
Improve download size, load and startup performance for Web builds, and set measurable targets for it
Solve uncommon, low-level problems across C++, C# and JavaScript, for example bringing multi-threading to parts of the runtime that are single-threaded today
Partner with teams across Unity who build on the Web platform, translating what they need into platform work
Mentor teammates and help set the bar for code quality across the team
Keep Unity at the frontier of the Web's constantly evolving capabilities

What We're Looking For

Deep, hands-on proficiency with C++ in performance sensitive code
Development experience with WebAssembly, using Emscripten and/or LLVM
Ability to decompose complex technical problems and complete them on your own technical judgment
Experience profiling, debugging and optimizing across the native and browser boundary
Working knowledge of C# and JavaScript
Effective written/verbal communication with peers, managers and key decision makers in other teams
A proven track record of mentoring engineers and raising code quality standards

You might also have

Experience contributing to a browser engine or browser runtime
Deeper domain knowledge of rendering, physics or audio in a real-time 3D engine
Familiarity with compression methodologies and build size reduction

During your internship, you will be working with your team as well as the Product Managers in our Project Team. Together, you will be developing our application for the Windows, Android and iOS platforms. This includes communication with our meters through a serial or wireless connection.

XAML

Did you know? Only about half of our team drinks coffee — the rest run on pure code, energy drinks, or maybe just sheer willpower.

We are looking for a motivated student who is ready to work with applications and whose commitment and theoretical knowledge can contribute to further development across platforms.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Help build the next generation of interactive sports experiences at Trackman.

Trackman is a global leader in sports tracking technology, trusted by professional athletes, coaches, teams, and sports organizations around the world. We are looking for a Unity Developer or Senior Unity Developer who is passionate about building high-quality interactive experiences and wants to help shape the future of our virtual sports products.

You will join a cross-functional team developing a diverse portfolio of interactive applications from family-friendly casual games and skill-based sports experiences to products supporting our growing baseball business.

The role

As a Unity Developer, you will develop and evolve products used by customers around the world. You will work across the full development lifecycle – building new features, supporting multiple platforms, improving performance and contributing to the technical architecture behind our products.

A key focus will be ABS Challenge, our interactive baseball solution supporting challenge and review situations. The product is expanding to additional platforms, including iPad and other mobile devices, and you will play an important role in creating a smooth, performant, and maintainable cross-platform experience.

At the same time, we are modernizing our software architecture across several products and teams. If you have experience with backend systems, APIs or software architecture, you will have the opportunity to contribute to these initiatives and help shape the technology foundation for future Trackman products.

Your key areas of focus

Develop and evolve ABS Challenge, including expansion to new platforms.
Support the development of View, part of our new software architecture.
Contribute to scalable software architecture supporting future products.

What You Will Do

Design, develop and maintain applications and features in Unity and C#.
Develop our portfolio of casual games, skill-based experiences and baseball products.
Bring ABS Challenge to new platforms, including iPad and other mobile devices.
Optimize application performance, stability and usability across platforms.
Develop tools and technical solutions that improve development workflows and team productivity.
Collaborate closely with designers, artists, product owners and developers.
Investigate and solve technical challenges across existing and new products.
Contribute to architecture discussions and engineering best practices.
Support backend integrations and services where relevant.

Job Requirements

What we are looking for

You have professional experience developing applications or games using Unity and C#, combined with a strong understanding of software development principles.

Ideally, You Also Bring

A relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Game Development or similar – or equivalent professional experience.
Experience developing and maintaining products across multiple platforms.
A solid understanding of software architecture, code quality and testing.
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to technical challenges.
A collaborative mindset and an interest in working across disciplines.
Experience in leveraging modern AI tools and workflows to accelerate development, improve quality and support continuous learning.

What You Might Grow Into

As you develop within the role, you'll have opportunities to:

Own larger technical systems and features.
Help shape software architecture and technical direction.
Drive engineering best practices.
Mentor and support other developers.
Expand your expertise in backend services, APIs, and cloud technologies.

Technologies you may work with

Our Technology Landscape Includes

Unity
C#
Cross-platform development and deployment
Windows, Android, iOS/iPadOS and other platforms
GraphQL APIs and backend integrations
Azure DevOps
CI/CD pipelines and automated workflows
Software architecture and design patterns
Performance optimization

Experience with all of these is not required. We are interested in developers with a strong Unity/C# foundation who are motivated to learn and contribute across our technology stack.

An interest in sports, gaming or fitness is a plus, and golf or baseball knowledge is welcome, but certainly not required.

What We Offer

At Trackman, you will have the opportunity to:

Build products used by customers and professional sports organizations around the world.
Work across multiple products and sports, including golf and baseball.
Help shape the future architecture of Trackman's interactive product ecosystem.
Work with talented colleagues across software, design, product, hardware and other disciplines.
Be part of a technology environment spanning sports simulation, radar, computer vision, real-time data and software development.
Grow professionally as Trackman continues to expand globally.

You will also become part of an informal and ambitious culture with plenty of social activities, from Dungeons & Dragons and winter bathing to bouldering, golf tournaments, parties and much more. And, quite possibly, the best lunch in Denmark.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!
