Meet the Team

Join Cisco's ASEAN & Korea Customer Experience (CX) architecture team. You will be the senior technical lead for our most strategic customers — designing multi-domain architectures across networking, data centre, security, cloud and AI infrastructure, guiding delivery, and driving adoption to measurable business outcomes. You will work alongside Sales, Systems Engineering, Customer Success, CX Delivery, TAC, BU/Product and partners, and use Cisco's digital lifecycle and telemetry platforms (Cisco IQ, Cloud Control, observability and automation tooling) to make architecture decisions data-driven.

Your Impact

Account & architecture leadership — Lead the technical relationship for a focused portfolio of strategic accounts — from architecture and effort scoping (LOE) through delivery governance, adoption, QBRs and renewal.
Multi-domain design — Design and validate solutions across enterprise networking, SD-Access, SD-WAN/SASE, ACI, EVPN/VXLAN, security, cloud connectivity, Kubernetes and AI infrastructure.
Large-scale transformation — Lead mission-critical transformations and data centre migrations, owning technical risk, cutover strategy and operational readiness.
Validation to production — Run labs, PoCs and solution validations that prove customer use cases and create a clear path to production adoption.
Data-led lifecycle — Use telemetry, observability and lifecycle insights (Cisco IQ, Cloud Control, ThousandEyes) to drive architecture reviews, executive QBRs and risk mitigation.
Cloud control & governance — Advise on hybrid/multicloud governance — secure connectivity, policy, compliance, operational visibility and automation.
AI & automation — Apply AI, AIOps and automation to improve resilience, accelerate adoption and make delivery repeatable — grounded in Cisco security, privacy and responsible AI principles.
Critical escalations — Provide senior architecture leadership on escalations, coordinating TAC, BU engineering and partners to resolve issues and prevent recurrence.
Reuse & mentorship — Build reusable reference architectures, playbooks and automation assets adopted across the region; mentor architects and lead technical enablement.
Influence & presence — Feed field insight, adoption blockers and product gaps back to Cisco BU/Product and CX leadership; represent Cisco at customer briefings and events such as Cisco Live.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field with 15+ years of experience, or CCIE/CCDE with 12+ years, or equivalent practical experience.
Expert-level technical depth in networking and/or security (CCIE, CCDE or equivalent demonstrated experience).
Proven experience owning both pre-sales solution design and hands-on delivery for enterprise or service provider customers.
Track record leading complex engagements through architecture, implementation governance, adoption and operational handover.
Experience using telemetry, observability or lifecycle insights to guide architecture and customer outcomes.
Strong executive communication — able to explain strategy, tradeoffs, risk and business impact to VP/C-level stakeholders.
Experience leading large-scale network or data centre transformation in mission-critical environments (e.g. FSI).
Domain familiarity in at least one regulated vertical — Financial Services, Healthcare or Public Sector.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on with SD-Access, SD-WAN, ACI, EVPN/VXLAN, Zero Trust/SASE, cloud networking (AWS/Azure/GCP), containers and orchestration (Kubernetes), automation (Python, Ansible, Terraform) or AI/ML infrastructure (GPU platforms, MLOps).
Experience with Cisco IQ, Cloud Control, ThousandEyes, Splunk, Control Hub or similar lifecycle, observability and AIOps platforms.
Additional certification beyond CCIE — AWS/Azure/GCP Professional Architect, CISSP, PCNSE, CKA.
Track record building PoC labs, reference architectures or automation tooling reused by other teams.
Experience presenting at customer executive briefings and industry conferences, and mentoring or leading regional technical initiatives.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Summary

In this role, you will combine strong hands-on technical execution with close team collaboration, working alongside senior engineers, business analysts and architects to establish engineering best practices and ensure overall software excellence.

Contract Duration
: Full-Time (2-Year Limited Term with a strong possibility of extension or transition to an indefinite contract)

Detailed Description

Full professional level; applies software engineering expertise in a specific area of specialization. Work is performed within established professional standards, technical guidelines and project objectives. Works on problems of moderate to diverse scope where analysis of technical requirements, system architectures and data schemas requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Exercises technical judgment within defined procedures and software development practices to determine appropriate action. Receives general instructions on routine development tasks and detailed instructions on new projects or complex system assignments. Builds productive collaborative relationships across development, QA and business analyst teams.

Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:

Contribute actively to the software design and end-to-end delivery of scalable enterprise web applications using ASP.NET Core MVC and .NET 10, collaborating with senior engineers and the dedicated architect to implement robust technical solutions.
Support the modernization and rewrite process, migrating legacy Java and Java ADF application functionalities into a high-performance .NET architecture while ensuring functional parity.
Balance legacy modernization with new features enablement, designing and building brand-new product capabilities from scratch to deliver strategic business value.
Collaborate with senior engineers and the dedicated architect to implement robust architectural foundations, design RESTful APIs and optimize data flows integrated with Oracle DB.
Deliver clean, maintainable and scalable code by strictly adhering to SOLID principles and Clean Code practices.
Manage modern development workflows in GitLab, utilizing standardized branching strategies, merge request processes and CI/CD practices.
Work closely within a collaborative team environment, actively sharing knowledge on modern .NET development, participating in peer code reviews and contributing to a culture of continuous learning.
Ensure application reliability and stability by defining and implementing code testing standards, structured debugging and proactive performance optimization.
Proactively identify and resolve technical debt, modernize user interfaces and enhance application stability, security and performance.
Collaborate with IT/Business partners, leadership and global stakeholders to translate business requirements into clear technical specifications.
Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectural designs, system configurations and database schemas to ensure long-term maintainability.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the .NET ecosystem, with a strong passion for modern C# features and ASP.NET Core.
Solid expertise in software design and architecture (Dependency Injection, Repository Pattern, Clean Architecture and Modular Design), with the ability to propose and implement scalable solutions.
Advanced proficiency in Database Architecture and SQL, with experience optimizing Entity Framework Core integrated with Oracle DB (experience with other relational databases such as PostgreSQL or SQL Server is highly acceptable).
Competency in web development and frontend integration, combining ASP.NET Core MVC with JavaScript to build highly interactive, responsive and performant user interfaces using UI components (such as Telerik UI), along with basic HTML and CSS skills.
Hands-on experience with version control and modern Git workflows (GitLab, branch protection, Merge Requests) along with exposure to CI/CD automation pipelines.
Proven ability to work collaboratively within a development team, take technical ownership of features, manage priorities and drive quality standards through constructive code reviews.
Exceptional verbal and written English skills for cross-cultural collaboration, negotiating technical requirements and explaining complex .NET concepts to team members.
Flexibility to occasionally participate in technical discussions and align on architecture with managers and architects in the Canada timezone (EST).
Self-driven, proactive mindset with a focus on writing highly scalable, long-term maintainable code and a desire to contribute to architectural discussions.

Openness to utilizing modern development tools and AI-assisted engineering practices is preferred.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description:
Software Engineer

Despre noi

Suntem un start-up care sprijină SOLOprenorii în drumul lor spre succes. Peste 30.000 de freelanceri, medici, IT-iști și antreprenori români au ales în ultimii 5 ani să își gestioneze PFA-ul cu SOLO, și asta ne face și mai ambițioși. Vrem să ajungem cât mai curând la 100.000 de clienți activi. Misiunea noastră este să transformăm birocrația într-un sistem simplu, digital și automatizat.

Despre ce este rolul?

Construim un produs folosit deja de zeci de mii de oameni și vrem să-l ducem la următorul nivel.

Problema pe care o rezolvăm nu e simplă: legislație complicată, multe excepții și așteptări mari de la utilizatori.

Căutăm un engineer care vrea să contribuie la soluții reale și să crească într-un mediu cu impact direct în produs.

Misiunea ta în acest rol

Vei lucra pe probleme reale ale utilizatorilor noștri , unele bine definite, altele în curs de clarificare
Vei contribui la implementarea și îmbunătățirea sistemelor existente
Vei colabora cu echipa pentru a livra funcționalități în producție
Vei participa la decizii tehnice și vei învăța cum să le iei în timp
Vei folosi AI în workflow-ul tău pentru a crește viteza și calitatea

Ce ne dorim de la tine

2–4 ani experiență în dezvoltare software;
Experiență cu backend (ideal .NET Core, dar nu obligatoriu);
Experiență cu baze de date relaționale și modelare de date;
Capacitatea de a lucra pe probleme care nu sunt complet definite;
Interes pentru produs și modul în care este folosit de utilizatori;
Te folosești de AI (Cursor, Claude, Copilot sau similar) pentru a-ți îmbunătăți modul de lucru și înveți să validezi output-ul.

Ce oferim

Salariu competitiv (în funcție de nivel);
Zile nelimitate de concediu (pe care le și folosim);
Program flexibil;
Abonament premium la clinicile medicale Regina Maria;
Abonament Bookster;
Acces la tool-uri AI (Claude, Cursor, Copilot etc.) și buget de utilizare;
Lucrăm hibrid din București. Poți lucra până la 2 zile pe săptămână de acasă. În perioada de probă, te așteptăm zilnic la birou: e cea mai rapidă cale să înțelegi contextul, să cunoști echipa, și să ajungi să livrezi pe cont propriu.

Despre cum lucrăm în general

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

Creșterea continuă și accelerată e ceva fundamental - ne așteptăm de la fiecare coleg să își dorească să se dezvolte și să profite pe deplin de toate resursele pe care le punem la dispoziție pentru învățare. Apoi, ne așteptăm ca fiecare coleg să fie interesat mai ales de rezultat, nu doar de efort în sine.
Clientul este în centrul activității noastre: îi înțelegem nevoia reală, îl tratăm cu empatie și alegem soluții simple și clare pentru el. Facem toate acestea în timp ce ne comportăm cu bunăvoință unii față de alții, oferim și acceptăm feedback și menținem și consolidăm un spirit de echipă în care să ne regăsim cu toții.
Fiind un start-up, ne dorim alături oameni energici, curajosi, autonomi, cu o gândire dincolo de tipare, cu simțul umorului și cu o mare flexibilitate mentală, pentru că adesea realitatea din jur și activitățile noastre de zi cu zi se schimbă din mers în timp ce direcția rămâne clară: suntem aici pentru a sprijini SOLOprenorii.

Automated guest communication across channels
Operational forecasting
Cleaning and maintenance automation
Owner reporting and financial workflows
AI-powered monitoring and alerts

PostgreSQL

Serverless architecture

Base360.ai
is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

Dynamic pricing intelligence

Automated guest communication across channels
Operational forecasting
Cleaning and maintenance automation
Owner reporting and financial workflows
AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Move Fast and Own Delivery

Own projects end-to-end—from understanding an operator’s problem to architecture, implementation, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

Bring senior engineering judgment to technical decisions, code reviews, and the reliability of the systems you build.

Python

React
TypeScript
Supabase
PostgreSQL
AWS
Serverless architecture
OpenAI APIs
Twilio
Stripe

GitHub Actions

Strong experience building and owning production-grade software systems

The ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions

Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations
AI agents and workflow automation
Event-driven architectures
Supabase
AWS serverless infrastructure

Build Something Meaningful

Extreme Ownership

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.

Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.

The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:

Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.

The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.

To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. Wir haben das klare Ziel: unser Wien tagtäglich zu einer lebens- und liebenswerten Stadt zu machen, in der sich jede*r Bewohner*in in gleichem Maße und bei gleicher Qualität auf unsere Leistungen und Services verlassen kann. Dazu brauchen wir Sie!

Informationen Dienststelle

Wir, die Magistratsabteilung 01 - Wien Digital sind eine innovative, serviceorientierte IT-Abteilung. Mit unseren rund 1.200 Mitarbeiter*innen schaffen wir für den Magistrat der Stadt Wien und den Wiener Gesundheitsverbund innovative Services im Bereich der Informations- und Kommunikationstechnologie (IKT).

Analog war gestern. Wien (ist) Digital!

Ihr Aufgabengebiet

Sind Sie bereit, mit Ihrer technischen Expertise innovative und interoperable IT-Services für das Gesundheitswesen zu entwickeln und die digitale Patient*innenversorgung aktiv mitzugestalten? Das Team SW-Komponenten Gesundheit trägt die Verantwortung für die Bereitstellung von Services aus den Themenbereichen Digitale Patient*innenakte und eHealth/ELGA, Klinische Dokumentation, Pflegedokumentation, Patient*innenadministration, Patient*innenabrechnung und Leistungsverzeichnisse. Darunter fallen insbesondere die Konzeption, Weiterentwicklung, Wartung und der Support während des gesamten Lifecyles der Services sowie die Mitwirkung bei der wirtschaftlichen und strategischen Planung und die Beratung in Bezug auf den Einsatz bestehender und neuer Lösungen des Themenbereichs.

Sie übernehmen die technische Beratung von Kund*innen bei der Umsetzung von IT-Anforderungen im Gesundheitswesen, insbesondere Anforderungen an Interoperabilität (z.B. HL7 FHIR, CDA, IHE), Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit und die Integration medizinischer Fachsysteme

Sie wirken bei der Erstellung und Wartung von Rechte- und Rollenkonzepten
Sie verantworten die Prüfung auf technische Machbarkeit sowie die Anlage von technischen Berechtigungsrollen

Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Fullstack Entwicklung, Erweiterung und 3rd Level Support komplexer Software Anwendungen und IT-Systemen, idealerweise im Umfeld klinischer Dokumentation, Befunderstellung, Patient*innenverwaltung, medizinischer Fachanwendungen oder dem standardisierten Austausch von Gesundheitsdaten (z.B. HL7 FHIR, CDA, IHE)

Sie haben sehr gute Kenntnisse in .NET und anderen Frameworks und Tools (z.B. Spring, React, Angular, Node.js) sowie dem Umgang mit Microsoft SQL Server und anderen Datenbanken (z.B. SQL, NoSQL)

Sie bringen ein Verständnis von Software Architektur und Systemdesign, einschließlich der Erstellung von Lösungskonzepten und Machbarkeitsanalysen
Sie haben ein Verständnis der Datenschutzvorgaben und Anforderungen aus dem Informationssicherheit Management

jobs.title: Consultant (Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und Power Platform) (all genders welcome)
jobs.description:
Arbeiten bei COSMO CONSULT ist anders.

Entdecke unser Universum und lasse Dich von der positiven Energie der COSMOnaut*innen anstecken.

Gestalte die Zukunft von und mit Menschen und wachse mit uns gemeinsam.

Erlebe echte Wertschätzung in einem sicheren Umfeld voll Leidenschaft und Innovation - ganz unabhängig davon, wann und von wo aus Du arbeiten möchtest.

Werde Teil des Teams und gehöre zu einem der weltweit führenden Microsoft-Partnern für Unternehmenstransformation und Digitalisierung.

Lebe Deinen Job anders
- bewirb Dich bei uns als

Consultant (Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und Power Platform)

Das macht Dich anders.

Wir sind auf einer Wellenlänge, wenn Du:

smarte Entscheidungen triffst. Du musst nicht immer die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen, aber immer mit bestem Gewissen gegenüber unseren Kunden, Kolleg*innen und COSMO entscheiden.
den Menschen bei all Deinen Überlegungen in den Mittelpunkt stellst. Du achtest auf die Bedürfnisse aller Menschen und agierst mit Empathie und Mitgefühl.
Verantwortung übernimmst. Du bist achtsam gegenüber Dir und Deinen Mitmenschen. Auf Dich kann man sich auch über Deinen Aufgabenbereich hinaus verlassen.
uns dabei unterstützt, großartige Teams zu bilden. Alle für Dich und Du für alle - gemeinsam stärker sein. Du machst den Unterschied in Deinem Team.
immer Dein Bestes gibst. Du musst nicht der oder die Beste sein, aber aus tiefstem Respekt gegenüber Dir und Deinem Umfeld immer das Bestmögliche geben.
den Mut hast zu wachsen. Du denkst nicht in Herausforderungen, sondern in Möglichkeiten. Du liebst es, Dich weiter zu entwickeln, suchst nach neuen Ideen und bringst diese aktiv ein.
Dinge mit Leidenschaft tust. Du weißt, was Dich antreibt und begeistert, lebst Deine Leidenschaft, inspirierst dadurch Dein Umfeld, hast mehr Spaß an Deiner Arbeit und bist erfolgreicher.

Deine Persönlichkeit und Motivation ist das, was Dich ausmacht.

Daher nehmen wir uns die Zeit und schauen alle Bewerbungen individuell durch.

Dein Alltag - nur ohne Alltag

Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Optimierung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform.
Dabei begleitest Du Projekte von der ersten Analyse über das Lösungsdesign bis zur Umsetzung und Einführung. Du verstehst die fachlichen Anforderungen unserer Kunden, übersetzt sie in tragfähige Lösungen und behältst dabei immer die End-to-End-Prozesse im Blick.

Je nach Projekt und Erfahrung übernimmst Du dabei unterschiedliche Aufgaben:

Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse und identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale.
Du führst Workshops mit Fachbereichen und weiteren Projektbeteiligten durch.
Du entwickelst strukturierte Lösungskonzepte und stimmst diese mit unseren Kunden ab.
Du setzt Lösungen selbst um oder koordinierst die Umsetzung im Team.
Du verantwortest Arbeitspakete und stellst Qualität, Standards und eine gute Dokumentation sicher.
Du bewertest Integrationen und Abhängigkeiten zu angrenzenden Systemen.
Du führst Schulungen durch und begleitest die Einführung, damit Lösungen im Arbeitsalltag nachhaltig genutzt werden.
Dabei arbeitest Du nicht nur innerhalb eines einzelnen Systems: Du denkst Prozesse, Daten und Anwendungen ganzheitlich und entwickelst Lösungen, die fachlich sinnvoll, technisch umsetzbar und langfristig skalierbar sind.

Hier bringst du Dich ein:

Du denkst Lösungen konsequent aus Nutzersicht und strukturierst sie in klare, skalierbare Use Cases.
Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in tragfähige Lösungen innerhalb der Microsoft-Plattform und verbindest fachliche und technische Perspektiven.
Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und internen Teams zusammen und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zielführend zusammen.
Du entwickelst Dein Know-how kontinuierlich weiter, bleibst technologisch am Puls der Zeit und teilst Dein Wissen aktiv.
Du bringst neue Ideen ein, hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen und gestaltest Veränderungen aktiv mit.

Dein Umfeld: Teams, Tools, Zusammenarbeit

Team & Setup

Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Projektteams mit Consultants, Entwickler*innen, Architekt*innen und weiteren Microsoft-Spezialist*innen.
Direkter Austausch mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Projektbeteiligten von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung von Lösungen.
Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten kombiniert mit engem Teamzusammenhalt, Wissensaustausch und fachlicher Zusammenarbeit.

Tools & Arbeitsweise

Arbeiten im Microsoft-Ökosystem rund um Dynamics 365 CRM (Sales, Customer Service und/oder Field Service), die Power Platform mit Power Apps, Power Automate und Dataverse sowie angrenzende Microsoft- und Azure-Lösungen.
Bewertung und Einsatz neuer Technologien, insbesondere zur Automatisierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen sowie zur Nutzung von KI-Potenzialen.
Strukturierte und priorisierte Arbeitsweise, auch in parallelen Projekten und dynamischen Kundenumgebungen.
Kombination aus eigenständiger Umsetzung, fachlicher Beratung und gezielter Steuerung im Projektteam.

Deine Lernkurve bei COSMO CONSULT

Woche 1–4

Du lernst unsere Projektmethoden, Kundenstrukturen und Lösungsansätze kennen.
Du bringst Deine bisherigen Erfahrungen aktiv in laufende Kundenprojekte ein und

übernimmst frühzeitig Verantwortung für erste Themen und Arbeitspakete.

Du verstehst, wie wir Anforderungen in konkrete Lösungen übersetzen und welchen Beitrag diese zum Geschäftserfolg unserer Kunden leisten.

Nach 3 Monaten

Du verantwortest eigene Arbeitspakete und setzt diese strukturiert und lösungsorientiert um.
Du arbeitest sicher mit Kunden und Projektteams zusammen und bringst Deine fachliche Expertise gezielt in Lösungsdesigns und Projektentscheidungen ein.
Du entwickelst Lösungen weiter und passt Dich flexibel an neue Anforderungen und Technologien an.

Nach 6 Monaten

Du berätst Kunden souverän bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und bringst Deine fachliche Expertise gezielt in Lösungsentscheidungen ein.
Du entwickelst bestehende Lösungsansätze innerhalb von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform weiter und berücksichtigst dabei fachliche, technische und organisatorische Zusammenhänge.
Du bringst eigene Ideen zur Optimierung von Lösungen, Methoden und Prozessen ein und unterstützt den Wissenstransfer innerhalb des Teams.

Das bringst Du mit:

Erfahrung in der Beratung, Konzeption oder Umsetzung von Lösungen mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
Praxiserfahrung mit der Microsoft Power Platform, insbesondere Power Apps, Power Automate und/oder Dataverse
Kenntnisse in mindestens einem relevanten Dynamics-365-Modul, zum Beispiel Sales, Customer Service oder Field Service
Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse, Systemgrenzen, Integrationen und End-to-End-Zusammenhänge
Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen zu analysieren und in klare, umsetzbare Lösungen zu übersetzen
Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Workshops und in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Projektteams
Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für fachliche Lösungen und deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung zu übernehmen
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Aus gesetzlichen Gründen weisen wir darauf hin, dass das kollektivvertragliche, monatliche Mindestgehalt für diese Position € 3.954,- brutto (Vollzeit) beträgt. Unsere tatsächlichen Gehaltspakete orientieren sich an aktuellen Marktgehältern und berücksichtigen selbstverständlich Deine Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

Du entscheidest wann und wo, damit es für Dich, Dein Team und Deinen Arbeitstag am besten passt.
Auf Deiner Reise bist Du nicht allein. Durch unser Level Up Programm gestalten wir Deine berufliche Zukunft gemeinsam.
Wir fragen nicht ob, sondern wie. Unsere Innovation Challenge und die Trainings in unserem COSMO College sind nur einige Beispiele dafür.
Es ist uns wichtig, dass es Dir gut geht. Das bringen wir durch verschiedene Wege und Benefits zum Ausdruck.
Wir kümmern uns um Mensch und Umwelt. Mit #thepowerofpeople schaffen wir einen sicheren Raum für eine positive, nachhaltige und internationale Zusammenarbeit.

Du möchtest Teil des Teams werden?

Dann bewirb Dich mit Deinen aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen und Deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittsdatum direkt online.

Du möchtest mehr #insideCOSMO?

We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect with strong technical leadership skills and a proven ability to design and implement scalable, high-performance solutions. The ideal candidate should have deep expertise in software architecture, systems integration, and cloud-based technologies. They should be able to align technical strategies with business goals, working closely with development teams and stakeholders to define architecture standards and ensure consistency across projects. Design and oversee the implementation of end-to-end technical solutions that align with business requirements and enterprise standards.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
This job advertisement is published on behalf of our partner Goldright.

Data is the fuel for AI and digital transformation – but only if it can be trusted.

This is where Goldright comes in: With our Enterprise Suite, we provide the essential ‘Trust Layer’ for global players and mid-sized companies. We deliver the reliable foundation that enables our customers to realize AI projects and make strategic decisions with confidence. But we don’t just enable AI for others; we breathe it ourselves.

YOUR JOB

As a Software Engineer
, you will be responsible for the continuous development and enhancement of our core product
. In this role, you will work across a broad technical spectrum, bringing in your own ideas to shape the product’s future, utilizing modern development practices—including integrating and developing AI features
directly within our solutions.

You will join a close-knit, Graz-based team of developers, collaborating tightly with Consultants, Operations and the IT department to deliver high-quality software.

Your Job’s Key Responsibilities Are

Developing high-quality software solutions and web application fundamentals using Java Core, Spring, and relational databases, with a willingness to dive into front-end topics when needed
Collaborating within a versatile team where everyone is encouraged to be a generalist, while still having room to focus on their preferred areas of expertise
Working closely with Consultants to ensure our API provides clean, flexible customization boundaries, enabling them to easily adapt the product to specific customer needs
Actively participating in our developer-driven agile workflow: enjoying 3-week sprints, dailies 3 times a week, and the freedom to self-select the tasks you want to work on
Taking part in collaborative sprint planning as well as joint sprint reviews with the entire team
Ensuring product quality through smart testing practices and conducting peer code reviews for major technical implementations
Driving innovation with AI: utilizing AI tools to accelerate your daily development and directly building advanced AI features for our product

Your Skills

Essential Skills:

3+ years of work experience in software development with Java
Completed technical studies related to software engineering or equivalent practical experience/training in software development
Solid knowledge of software development principles, database modeling (SQL), and relational databases.
Strong understanding of server-side web application fundamentals and an openness to working on both back-end and front-end topics
High personal standards regarding product quality, performance, and security
Good communication skills in English (minimum B2 level) to collaborate effectively with local and cross-functional teams
A proactive, collaborative mindset to bring your own ideas to the table, position oneself where the biggest impact can be made, and find creative solutions in a broad product landscape

Beneficial Skills

Knowledge of modern container and cluster technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
Experience with cloud technologies such as Azure or Google Cloud Platform
Solid experience with the Spring framework
Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript or other programming languages
Experience with Hibernate/JPA
Understanding of CI/CD processes and tools
German language skills

OUR OFFER

While we’re one company, each location has unique aspects and benefits. Here’s a glimpse of what to expect:

Flexible Working Models: Early bird or night owl? Thanks to our flexible working models, you start your workday when and where it fits you best. Plus, our hybrid work option lets you choose whether you prefer working more from the office or from home.
Career Development and Onboarding: Start your journey at Goldright with a structured onboarding and mentoring phase and continue with individual training opportunities. Our People Enablement team will support you in finding the best solution for you!
Company Summit: Exchange professional and personal experiences at our annual in-house conference! One of the highlights of our Company Summit is the vibrant networking environment it cultivates.
Social Events: Join our colleagues and build new connections at our social events such as pizza evenings, sports activities, Christmas parties, or milestone celebrations.
Snacks and Wellbeing: Fuel your productivity and taste buds with our monthly meal allowance and discounts at partner restaurants.
Mobility Support: Choose eco-friendly transportation! As we take our responsibility for the environment seriously, we support your climate-friendly transportation costs.

The actual salary depends on your qualifications and experience and is significantly above the minimum salary defined by the collective agreement. What is also important to us is to pay our employees an internally comparable salary. For legal reasons, we need to disclose the minimum annual salary for full time employment as stated in the current collective IT agreement, which is € 55,356 gross/year for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Fourthline, our mission is to fight financial crime. We help protect the global financial system by verifying millions of identities for banks, neobanks, online brokers, crypto exchanges, and insurers like N26, Trade Republic, flatexDEGIRO, Nationale Nederlanden, Qonto, Shine, Solarisbank, and more.

Having started our journey in January 2018, we're incredibly proud to count around 250 employees between our Amsterdam and Barcelona offices with over 50 nationalities.

Prevent financial crime by building best-in-class SaaS solutions with our talented Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Bank Account Verification (BAV) + Qualified Electronic Signatures (QES) teams in Barcelona
—we’re looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer who brings solid technical expertise, a product-driven mindset, and a collaborative spirit across diverse domains and skill levels.

As a senior backend engineer at Fourthline, you will:

Design, develop, maintain, and improve our microservices, and take responsibility for thorough testing and reliable deployments of your stories.
Professionally manage your tasks, priorities and deliverables, taking joint ownership with your teammates for the sprint goals.
Utilize your experience to contribute to our growth through lessons learned from your successes and failures.
Take responsibility for engineering excellence and participate in architectural decision-making within your team.
Contribute to thorough documentation—crucial for ensuring success and minimizing questions!
Understand the entire development lifecycle and work closely with other members in squads, including Platform and QA teams.
Employ both technical and soft skills to address challenges, recognizing that solutions often require a blend of technology-based and people-based strategies.

Emphasis on Collaboration

At Fourthline, we foster a collaborative culture informed by industry knowledge (FinTech) and deep understanding of our business objectives. You will actively participate in chapter meetings, knowledge sharing sessions and cross-discipline alignments with other teams and engineering disciplines.

Career Growth and Development

At Fourthline, we offer opportunities for learning and development, allowing you to work alongside and learn from experienced engineers. As you grow within our team, there are possibilities to grow to Staff Engineer level and beyond, with clear pathways to further your technical, problem solving and communication competencies, as well as build your knowledge of the FinTech industry.

Our Stack

.NET 5-8 – Our cloud-based microservices architecture includes REST APIs, Docker, Message Queues (RabbitMQ), RDBMS (PostgreSQL), Wolverine, Marten (Doc + Event stores), and much more!

Job Requirements

Minimum 5 years software development experience in one or more general-purpose programming languages.
Good knowledge of .NET 5-8, or .NET Core 3.x
Proficiency in C# (version 10 or later).
Experience in unit and integration testing with XUnit (MSTest/NUnit are a plus).
Familiarity with ORMs (EF Core) and knowledge of Linq.
Experience implementing REST APIs using .NET Web API.
Understanding of SOLID principles and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
Knowledge of common software design patterns.
Experience with Git and CI/CD in Azure DevOps.
Experience with cloud providers such as AWS and Azure; experience with EKS and Terraform is highly valued.
Ability to work on-site at our fantastic office in Barcelona at least 3 days a week as per our Hybrid Working Policy.
Language skills: English full professional proficiency.

At Fourthline, we believe diversity enriches our culture and inspires you to do your best work. We value your unique talents and perspectives, welcoming them into a safe and inclusive working environment, to ultimately deliver the best products to our customers and society. You're welcome here. Fourthline is for everyone.

Our hiring process is designed to be equal, fair, and transparent. We welcome people from all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, sexual orientations, ages, abilities, religions, and experiences in life. If you're excited about this role, but your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Software Developer - fully remote possible
jobs.description:
Your new home base at Körber is the Körber Supply Chain Consulting team.

A smoothly running supply chain of goods, end-to-end, is what makes today’s world go round. Here is your chance to become part of this challenge. At Körber Supply Chain Consulting, we work with our customers to envisage and implement their supply chains for tomorrow. We work with best-in-class software companies such as SAP and turn our customers’ end-to-end supply chain vision into reality. We bring supply-chain intelligence and advanced digital expertise gained through many projects. We ensure seamless integration into our customers’ overall IT landscapes, even down to driving automation technology at the hardware level.

If you enjoy software engineering and consulting applied to real-life challenges in warehousing, transport management, yard management and manufacturing execution, you do not need to look any further.

Your role in our team

Together with your team colleagues, you will support and maintain software solutions for innovative logistics systems for our national and international customers.
You will analyse incidents, troubleshoot issues and implement sustainable solutions to ensure stable system operations.
As a full-stack developer, you will maintain, enhance and optimise existing applications in .NET, C#, Java, JavaScript and 3-tier web architectures.
You will work closely with customers to resolve operational challenges and ensure the reliability and performance of productive systems.
You will implement change requests and enhancements within existing customer environments while ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
You will work with Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases to support and improve application performance.
Your primary focus will be on application support, maintenance, incident management and continuous improvement of existing customer solutions rather than project-driven software implementations or greenfield development.
You are willing to participate in a 24x7 support rotation to ensure that business-critical customer systems remain operational.

Your profile

You have a degree in business informatics, computer science or a comparable programme, or you have completed vocational training in IT.
You have gained initial professional experience in software development, application support, software maintenance or IT operations.
Candidates with junior to mid-level experience who are eager to develop within a support-oriented role are encouraged to apply.
Experience with .NET, C#, Java, JavaScript, databases or comparable technologies is beneficial.
Knowledge of JIRA, Azure DevOps, Git, SVN or similar tools is an advantage.
You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills as well as a structured approach to troubleshooting.
You possess strong communication skills, a customer-oriented mindset and enjoy working in an international environment.
You are fluent in English and are willing to participate in a 24x7 on-call and support model.

Your Benefits

Exciting challenges in national and international SAP implementation projects in different industries
Taking on responsibility and the opportunity to make a difference from day one. Compatibility of work, family and free time through flexible working hours, mobile working - also from home
Working in an environment with a good team spirit, solidarity, and mutual support
Personal development opportunities in a growing team
Flat hierarchies and short communication channels
Ongoing training and further education
Personal mentoring and individual development opportunities

Apply now and join our team!

Ready for your next step? Click on ‘Apply now’ to get started right away! As long as the position is advertised, you can apply at any time.

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity, and any other protected status. You can find out more about our culture here Culture at Körber - it's worth taking a look!

We are committed to providing an accessible working environment. Applications from people with a recognized disability under German law, including people with severe disabilities or equivalent status, are expressly welcome. We would appreciate it if you could voluntarily indicate this directly in your CV or cover letter so that we can support you as effectively as possible throughout the process. You can find out more about the work of our representative body for people with severe disabilities here. They are happy to answer any confidential questions you may have in advance.

If you have any questions or technical problems, please send us an e-mail to jobs@koerber.com.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect (Azure Cloud)
jobs.description:
Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.

Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.

We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

We’re looking for a Senior Solution Architect to take ownership of the technical direction and architecture roadmap for a portfolio of cloud-based SaaS solutions. This is a highly influential role where you’ll combine hands-on technical expertise with architectural leadership, helping shape secure, scalable, high-performing, multi-tenant applications built on Microsoft Azure.

You’ll work closely with agile development teams and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust technical solutions, guide key architectural decisions, and ensure successful delivery from design through implementation. You’ll also have the opportunity to mentor engineers, champion best practices, and help drive the evolution of our cloud technology landscape.

The ideal candidate will bring 7+ years of web and cloud development experience, strong expertise in Azure, C#, REST APIs, JavaScript/TypeScript, and a proven track record of architecting and delivering scalable, secure SaaS solutions. Experience leading development teams and a strong understanding of backend architecture, performance, and security are essential.

Responsibilities

Guide and own the system architecture roadmap and the key technical decisions for a portfolio of solutions.
Coordinate and lead agile development teams to design, estimate, develop, test and deliver commercial software products.
Communicate clearly the mission, architecture, deadlines, and expectations.
Perform an expert role in the development, configuration, support, and enhancement of Web and Cloud SaaS Multi-tenant solutions
Ensure system scalability and performance by utilizing proper architectural designs
Take an active role in project planning (estimations, timelines, and milestones) and progress tracking. Adjust plans and priorities as necessary.
Work closely with stakeholders to ensure all business requirements, interdependencies and impediments are understood
Write clean code to develop functional web applications and server-side applications
Develop and design generic, secure & scalable RESTful services and APIs
Mentor and coach more junior members of the team when appropriate
Perform other duties and responsibilities, as necessary.

Required Education

University degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent experience.

Required Experience

7+ years of Web and Cloud development using various technologies, frameworks, and tools
Demonstrated experience in architecting and implementing Cloud SaaS multi-tenant systems
Knowledge of Azure Cloud technologies, environment, and services (Application Gateway, Queues, Azure Function, B2C)
Expert knowledge of best practices in back-end architecture, including performance, security and scalability
Good experience with C#, JSON, REST APIs, JavaScript/TypeScript
Demonstrated experience in leading development teams
Working knowledge of Azure Dev Ops.
Domain knowledge in life-cycle assessment is an asset
Knowledge or experience in Delphi is an asset

Skills

Strong facilitation and coaching skills
Abilities to think creatively to find alternate solutions or creative ways to solve problems.
Work effectively independently and in a dynamic team environment.
Proven time management, organizational and follow-up skills to meet deadlines
Quality-oriented with a passion for customer satisfaction
Excellent interpersonal skills
Must be willing to learn new technologies and processes as needed.
Strong work ethic and professionalism
Good communication skills in English.

Remote

jobs.description:
Company Description

As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.

DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

The Project: Internal Support Tools Evolution

You are joining an initiative focused on the evolution, modernization of the Internal Application Landscape. This project involves the strategic transition of well-known cloud services and legacy .NET architectures into a next-generation, AI-augmented, and cloud-native software landscape.

Our goal is not simply to "maintain" the existing system, but to proactively transform it—ensuring sovereignty, high-performance scalability, and seamless handover readiness through disciplined engineering.

Our Engineering Philosophy

We operate at the intersection of Legacy Stability and Modern Innovation. Our approach is defined by:

AI-Augmented Engineering: We utilize advanced AI development environments (such as Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code) and cutting-edge model families to accelerate code comprehension, refactoring, and documentation.
Disciplined SDLC Patterns: We move beyond traditional development by implementing repeatable, evidence-based SDLC patterns. Every change is backed by structured engineering evidence and rigorous automated testing.
The "Strangler Fig" Modernization: We prioritize risk-mitigated evolution, using sophisticated patterns to wrap, refactor, and eventually replace legacy components.
High-Seniority Autonomy: We operate as a lean, highly autonomous unit. We value "technical detectives" who can navigate ambiguity and perform deep reverse engineering.

Mission

To drive the technical execution of both high-impact feature development and the deep-dive modernization of our legacy .NET ecosystem. You will be a specialist who finds satisfaction in solving complex puzzles, utilizing AI-assisted tools to accelerate the modernization of our core systems.

Role Focus

This role focuses on high-complexity coding, deep reverse engineering, and AI-augmented productivity. You will work in the trenches of the legacy codebase, extracting logic and implementing modern, testable solutions using the latest AI-powered development environments.

Key Responsibilities

Complex Feature & Refactoring: Design and implement sophisticated new functionalities within the existing .NET ecosystem, ensuring seamless integration with legacy components.
Deep Reverse Engineering: Analyze and deconstruct complex, undocumented, or "spaghetti" legacy code to understand underlying business rules and technical flows.
AI-Augmented Coding: Proactively utilize AI coding assistants and advanced environments (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, or VS Code extensions) to accelerate code comprehension, documentation, and refactoring.
Robust Testing & Stability: Write high-quality unit and integration tests to "wrap" legacy modules, providing a safety net for all refactoring efforts.
Technical Troubleshooting: Act as a high-level escalation point for complex bugs and performance bottlenecks within the legacy environment.
Internal Tooling: Utilize Microsoft PowerApps to build rapid, lightweight administrative or maintenance utilities to support the development and operations lifecycle.

Qualifications

Experience: 6+ years of professional software development experience, with deep expertise in the .NET/C# stack.
Legacy Navigation: Proven experience working with older .NET versions (e.g., .NET Framework) and managing the complexities of monolithic architectures.
AI Tooling Proficiency: Hands-on familiarity with AI coding assistants, prompt engineering, or local model experimentation.
Core Skills: Mastery of SOLID principles, design patterns, and advanced debugging/profiling techniques.
Testing Mindset: Strong commitment to TDD and automated testing (Unit/Integration) to protect the legacy core.

Additional Information

Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Server Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

General Info

This position is on-site in Budapest and requires EU residency or an exiting EU work visa.

We are developing a breakthrough imaging and 3D technology platform currently under provisional patent. The Senior Backend Systems Engineer builds and maintains the production server software that delivers this platform to end users — the high-throughput API backend, the ML inference gateway that serves our models, and the internal control-plane services that hold the whole system together. Our technology is developed and trained on our on-premises GPU cluster; this role is responsible for the software that takes those trained models and our product experiences and serves them reliably to hundreds of thousands of concurrent users.
This is, first and foremost, a software engineering role. The person in this position writes solid production C++ on the hot paths where throughput, tail latency, and memory behavior are first-class product attributes; writes the Python services where development velocity, clarity, and integration breadth matter most; writes the bash and shell tooling that automates build, deployment, and operational tasks; and designs the concurrency, I/O, and state-management strategies that let live user connections survive instance failure, rolling deployment, and capacity rebalance without the end user noticing. The role exists because shipping an imaging and ML platform at scale requires server software written deliberately, not assembled from configuration.
This is a hands-on, high-ownership senior role focused on writing efficient, scalable server software. DevOps experience — cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and observability — is a strong plus and part of how the person in this role ships and operates their own code, but the primary focus is the software itself.
Tasks

Server Software & Performance Engineering

Design, write, and maintain the production server software that runs the Company’s platform: the API backend that serves the website, mobile, and e-commerce traffic; the ML inference gateway that fronts our GPU-backed model serving; and the internal control-plane services that coordinate them.
Write the performance-critical code paths in modern C++ — the request hot paths where latency budgets are measured in milliseconds, the dispatch and batching logic where efficiency depends on careful queueing, and the data paths where allocation behaviour and memory layout determine whether the system meets its throughput targets.
Write the Python services that surround and complement the C++ core — control-plane logic, integration glue, request orchestration, and the parts of the stack where development velocity and clarity matter more than raw performance.
Write the bash and shell tooling that automates build, deployment, data movement, and routine operational tasks, and keep that tooling reliable and maintainable.
Design and implement graceful connection and session migration so that live user connections survive instance failure, rolling deployment, and capacity rebalance — handed off to healthy instances without the end user perceiving an interruption.
Maximize throughput and minimize tail latency at the hot paths through deliberate, justified choices in concurrency model, non-blocking I/O strategy, memory and allocation behaviour, serialization format, and batching. Treat response time as a product attribute, not an operations metric.
Profile, diagnose, and optimize performance end-to-end — from CPU and GPU utilization through network and storage paths — and fix root causes in the server code rather than working around them in infrastructure.

ML Inference Serving

Contribute to the inference gateway as a software engineering problem: request batching, GPU memory management, model versioning, request-level latency budgets, and graceful degradation under overload.
Support the training-to-serving handoff in partnership with the ML team: model packaging and artifact format, staged rollouts and version pinning, and the operational contract between the on-premises training cluster and the cloud serving tier.
Build inference-time observability — request-level traces and per-model latency telemetry — so model performance is debuggable in production and inference regressions can be investigated quickly.

Platform & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work within the service boundaries, deployment patterns, data and caching layers, and performance constraints of the platform, and contribute to their evolution for the website, e-commerce, and mobile API backend.
Partner closely with the Mobile Software Engineer on the mobile API backend — authentication, data synchronization, media upload and download, offline-capable request patterns, and the latency and reliability contract that the mobile client depends on.
Integrate with third-party systems: e-commerce engine, product-supply and fulfilment systems, payment processors, and communication services.
Contribute to the data architecture: operational databases, caches, object storage, analytics pipelines, and the movement of data between on-premises and cloud environments.

Infrastructure & Operations

Deploy, operate, and reason about the systems you write. You are responsible for your code in production, including its observability, its failure modes, and its cost. A senior backend engineer who can run their own code in production is exactly what this role is asking for.
Work fluently with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) — compute, networking, storage, identity, and the operational surface — to deploy your services and the platform around them. Use infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent), container orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines as engineering tools.
Establish the observability practices for your code: meaningful metrics, structured logs, distributed traces, and dashboards that make production behaviour intelligible. Define service-level objectives for the services you own.
Participate in the on-call rotation for the systems you build, and help drive incident response when something you own breaks in production. Blameless postmortems and follow-through on remediation are part of the role.

Collaboration & Craft

Contribute to architecture and design discussions for backend systems and ML serving, review proposals from teammates, and push back constructively to raise the bar for production quality.
Mentor less-experienced engineers through code review, design review, and pair-programming on hard problems. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, not an engineering management role.
Maintain architectural documentation, design records, and operational runbooks as living, accurate artifacts — not write-once shelf-ware.

Requirements

Education & Experience

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
At least five years of relevant backend systems, distributed-systems, or platform-software engineering experience.
Demonstrated track record of having personally written significant portions of at least one high-throughput production server system — not having only operated one that someone else wrote. Code samples, open-source contributions, or detailed system descriptions in interview will be expected.
Hands-on production experience deploying and operating your own services, including cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability.

Skills & Competencies

Solid proficiency in modern C++ (C++17 or later) for production server software — concurrency primitives, non-blocking I/O, memory and allocation behaviour, and the discipline to write C++ that is fast and correct under sustained production load.
Strong proficiency in Python for service implementation, control-plane logic, and integration tooling. The ability to choose deliberately between C++ and Python for a given component, and to make the two interoperate cleanly, is part of the job.
Comfortable and effective in bash / shell scripting for automation, deployment, and day-to-day operational work in a Linux environment.
Solid understanding of high-throughput, low-tail-latency server design: concurrency models, event-loop and threaded architectures, connection and session state management, backpressure, graceful degradation, and transparent failover across instances.
Strong DevOps experience is a significant plus: cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure acceptable), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent), container orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines used confidently as everyday engineering tools.
Experience with GPU-based ML inference serving — request batching, GPU memory management, model versioning, and the latency-versus-throughput tradeoffs specific to inference workloads — is a strong plus. Familiarity with serving frameworks (Triton, TorchServe, custom) is welcome, but the ability to reason about inference serving from first principles matters more than experience with any particular framework.
Solid understanding of modern observability practice — metrics, structured logs, distributed traces, and the discipline of designing for debuggability rather than retrofitting it.
Additional fluency in Go or Rust is a plus, particularly for systems-software work where the C++/Python split is not the right answer.
Ability to handle confidential and pre-patent technical material with discretion, and to follow the Company’s IP and data-handling policies rigorously.
High degree of curiosity, craftsmanship, and resilience; calm and methodical under production pressure.

Additional Preferred Experience

Experience designing or shipping inference serving infrastructure for computer vision, hyperspectral, or other high-data-volume model classes — where bandwidth, batching, and GPU memory layout dominate the engineering.
Experience with hybrid architectures spanning on-premises GPU clusters and cloud serving — model export, artifact management, and the training-to-serving handoff.
Open-source contributions to backend systems, distributed-systems, or ML serving infrastructure.
Experience with high-volume transactional backends, payment integration, or multi-region resilience engineering.

Candidates must be eligible to work in Hungary, with fluent English knowledge, both written and oral.
Compensation

The base salary range for this position is HUF 2,000,000 – HUF 2,500,000 gross per month, paid in twelve monthly installments. The range reflects a full-time, senior-level engagement and is calibrated to the Hungarian market for senior backend systems engineering with hands-on production experience writing high-throughput server software. This is negotiable for exceptional candidates.
The offered starting salary within this range will be determined on the basis of objective, gender-neutral criteria, including the candidate’s demonstrated depth of production C++ on high-throughput server systems, proficiency across Python and bash for service and operational work, breadth of hands-on DevOps and production-operations experience, and track record of shipping and running efficient, scalable server software. Advanced domain knowledge and meaningful contributions in adjacent areas (for example, GPU-based ML inference serving, computer vision or hyperspectral inference, high-volume e-commerce backends, or open-source systems software) are factors that may justify positioning toward the upper end of the range.
In addition to base salary, the total compensation package includes a discretionary performance bonus and statutory and customary benefits as applicable under Hungarian law. Details of the bonus component will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.
This salary range is disclosed in accordance with the pay transparency obligations arising from Directive (EU) 2023/970 and its transposition into Hungarian law. Candidates will not be asked about their prior or current compensation at any stage of the recruitment process.

jobs.description:
About Us

Base360.ai
is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for a highly ambitious Senior Software Engineer
who wants to build systems that solve real problems at scale. You'll build, ship, automate, and deliver products that directly impact property managers, their teams, and their guests.

If you're excited by APIs, automation, AI agents, cloud infrastructure, and building products from the ground up, we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll help architect and scale Base360.ai—the platform powering every aspect of a short-term rental business.

You'll build customer-facing products, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, integrations, and operational systems that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will span the entire short-term rental lifecycle: from listing distribution, pricing, and bookings to guest stays, property operations, and financial reporting.

Your Mission

Build the Core Platform

Design and develop scalable applications, services, and APIs that power reservations, availability, pricing, payments, guest experiences, and property operations.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Systems

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Design API-First Architecture

Create robust APIs that connect internal services, booking channels, third-party providers, and customer systems.

Integrate the Ecosystem

Build and maintain integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other strategic partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Scale Infrastructure

Deploy and manage cloud-native infrastructure designed for reliability, performance, and global growth across multiple property management businesses.

Solve Complex Operational Problems

Build Solutions For

Real-time reservation and availability synchronization
Dynamic pricing intelligence
Smart lock access and key management
Automated guest communication across channels
Operational forecasting
Cleaning and maintenance automation
Owner reporting and financial workflows
AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Move Fast and Own Delivery

Own projects end-to-end—from understanding an operator’s problem to architecture, implementation, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

Bring senior engineering judgment to technical decisions, code reviews, and the reliability of the systems you build.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

Python
FastAPI
React
TypeScript
Supabase
PostgreSQL
AWS
Serverless architecture
OpenAI APIs
Twilio
Stripe
Docker
GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

Strong experience building and owning production-grade software systems
Experience with FastAPI, Python, React, or similar frameworks
Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, and cloud architecture
Experience designing scalable backend systems and reliable data models
The ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions
Strong problem-solving skills and a product mindset
Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency
A bias toward action, shipping, and learning from real users
The ability to balance delivery speed with maintainability and reliability

Bonus Points For Experience With

Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems
Multi-tenant SaaS platforms
Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations
AI agents and workflow automation
Event-driven architectures
Supabase
AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First 12 Months

Core short-term rental workflows are automated through systems you've built
Property managers spend less time on manual administration
Reservations, availability, payments, and operational data move reliably between systems
New integrations are deployed and maintained reliably
AI-powered workflows become part of customers’ everyday operations
The platform supports more operators and properties while maintaining reliability and performance
Base360.ai helps customers grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Extreme Ownership

Have the freedom and responsibility to make technical decisions and deliver systems that matter.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment
You prefer a narrowly defined role with limited product involvement
You need detailed instructions for every task
You avoid ownership and accountability
You're comfortable shipping work without taking responsibility for its quality

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

Job Title: L2 Application Support Engineer (Integration & Middleware)

IBM CP4I (ACE, MQ, API Connect), Spring Boot, Red Hat OpenShift.

The Integration Support is responsible for the health and reliability of the enterprise middleware layer. the L2 engineers to manage complex data flows between systems, ensuring that Spring Boot
services and IBM CP4I
components (MQ, ACE, APIC) are performant, secure, and highly available.

Strategic Technical Leadership
End-to-End Traceability: tracing transaction flows from the API Gateway (API Connect) through the Enterprise Service Bus (ACE) to the backend Microservices (Spring Boot).
Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Spearhead deep-dive investigations into middleware failures, such as message losses in MQ, synchronization errors in ACE, or JVM crashes in Spring Boot.
Platform Governance: Oversee the stability of integration components running on Red Hat OpenShift, ensuring optimal resource (CPU/Memory) allocation and pod scaling.
Security Enforcement: Manage and troubleshoot security protocols, including Mutual TLS (mTLS), OAuth2, and JWE/JWS within the integration layer.
Detailed Technical Responsibilities
IBM Cloud Pak for Integration (CP4I)
App Connect Enterprise (ACE): Troubleshoot message flows, ESQL logic errors, and adapter connectivity issues (SAP, Database, File).
IBM MQ: Manage queue managers, resolve channel retries, and investigate dead-letter queues or message persistence issues.
API Connect: Resolve issues related to API definitions, security policies, and Gateway (DataPower) latency.
Backend Microservices (Spring Boot)
Performance Tuning: Analyze JVM thread dumps and heap dumps to resolve memory leaks or high CPU utilization in microservices.
Connectivity Debugging: Troubleshoot Spring Boot integration with databases (JPA/Hibernate) and external messaging systems (JMS/Kafka).
Log Aggregation: Utilize ELK/Splunk to correlate logs across multiple microservices to identify points of failure in a distributed architecture.
Technical Skill Set
Integration Platforms: Mastery of IBM CP4I (specifically ACE, MQ, and API Connect).
Development Frameworks: Advanced knowledge of Java and Spring Boot (Spring Integration, Spring Cloud).
Containerization: Expert-level proficiency in Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes.
Protocols & Standards: Expert understanding of REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, AMQP, and MQTT.
Monitoring Tools: Hands-on experience with IBM Instana, Dynatrace, or Prometheus/Grafana.
Qualifications
Experience: 5+ years in Middleware or Integration Support
Currently residing in KSA
Complex Problem Solving: Ability to debug asynchronous communication patterns and distributed transactions.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Certifications (Preferred): IBM Cloud Pak for Integration Specialist, Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Integration Uptime: Achieving 99.99% availability for critical middleware components.
L2 Resolution Rate: Maximizing the number of integration issues resolved without escalation to L3 Engineering.
MTTR: Reducing the time taken to identify and fix failures in the message delivery pipeline.

As a full stack developer, you will be using the latest C# .NET Core for API development alongside Angular on the front-end. These roles would be well suited to individuals who would enjoy working in a collaborative environment, where they will have the opportunity to expand the scope of their role over time.

myairops is a leader of SaaS products to the aviation industry. We have customers across the globe with diverse challenges including corporate flight departments, brokers, medical providers, military and business aviation operators. Our goal is to bring everything that aircraft operators need into a single customer-focused suite of products. Whether you are focused on flight operations, charter-sales brokering, aircraft management, continuing airworthiness, operating an airport or fixed base operation, or provide ground handling services, our platform has a solution. Our team are currently based in the UK, Poland, and the USA.

SQL

Angular
General network knowledge: HTTP/S and asynchronous web communications

Microservices

ORMs - Dapper, Entity Framework

Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects and Engineering teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.

Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives and backlog refinement.

Professional software development experience, including significant experience developing enterprise applications.
Experience developing applications using Angular (Angular 12+) and TypeScript.
Experience building enterprise-scale front-end applications.

Experience designing and consuming REST APIs.

Experience using source control systems such as Git.

Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
Experience writing unit and integration tests.
Ability to work independently and contribute to technical delivery activities.
Analytical thinking, problem-solving and communication skills.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
Knowledge of authentication and authorisation technologies including SSO, OAuth, OpenID Connect and SAML.
Experience with Power BI, data integration and ETL processes.

Awareness of AI-enabled applications, including LLMs and prompt engineering concepts.

Experience mentoring colleagues and contributing to communities of practice.

new_jobs.description:
Title:
Full Stack Developer
Location:
Hybrid (Warrington, United Kingdom)
Company:
GTMaritime (Valstone Portfolio)

About the Company:
GT Maritime provides mission-critical maritime cybersecurity and communications software to 2,000 companies and 16,000 vessels worldwide — roughly a quarter of the world's non-navy fleet. Based in Warrington, UK, GT Maritime operates as a focused, technically rigorous business with a strong culture of quality and long-term ownership. GT Maritime is part of the Valstone portfolio.

About Valstone:
Valstone is an industrial software conglomerate that acquires and operates mission-critical software businesses across agriculture, logistics, food processing, bulk materials, and manufacturing. With 19 acquisitions completed across Canada, the USA, and the UK, Valstone takes a long-term, buy-and-hold approach — building businesses rather than exiting them. Valstone is part of the Valsef Group, a Montreal-based holding company. Sister entities include Valsoft (130+ acquisitions, $3B+ valuation), Permanent Corp, Valnet, and Valsef Capital.

Valstone at a Glance (Part of the Valsef Group)
19 acquisitions completed
4 core verticals
Canada, USA and UK operations
Buy and hold — no exit horizon
$200M revenue target by 2026

About the Role:
Reporting to the Head of Engineering, this Full Stack Developer role sits at the centre of GT Maritime's next phase of product development. The team is building the next generation of GT Maritime's platform — the layer where customers see what is happening across their entire fleet.

This hire will design and build partner API integrations across the cybersecurity stack — endpoint protection, network security, user awareness training, and SIEM/SOC tooling — and set the standard for test-driven development across the codebase. This is a hands-on, permanent role. You will not just build to spec — you will model TDD practice for the rest of the team through the code you write every day.

Responsibilities

𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭
Design and build partner API integrations across GT Maritime's cybersecurity stack — endpoint protection, network security, user awareness training, and SIEM/SOC tooling.
Write clean, modular, well-tested code following object-oriented design principles. Participate in code reviews and hold a high bar for what ships.
Work within six-week Shape Up build cycles, collaborating with the Head of Engineering and Product on scoping, requirements, and effort estimation.
Use AI-powered development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as standard instruments throughout the development workflow.

𝐓𝐞𝐬𝐭-𝐃𝐫𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 & 𝐐𝐮𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲
Champion and model TDD practice across the team — write tests first, every time, and make that standard infectious.
Own test coverage, regression strategy, and acceptance criteria validation for integration code.
Contribute to post-release reviews and continuous improvement of the delivery process.

𝐒𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐲
Promote secure coding practices and conduct security-focused code reviews aligned with ISO 27001 certification.
Support vulnerability identification and remediation as part of the everyday development workflow.
Enforce least-privilege access and secure infrastructure configuration across the integration layer.

𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐎𝐩𝐬 & 𝐈𝐧𝐟𝐫𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬
Work alongside DevOps to understand and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, AWS resource management, and deployment practices.
Support monitoring, logging, and alerting improvements that help the team detect and resolve issues faster.

Qualifications
